list the likely-new locations. Decreases print a `stale-baseline` line and also
fail: to a lexical scanner an honest fix and a matcher-evading refactor (the
"7A lesson" — routing counted call sites through a wrapper so the token
disappears) look identical, so a reduction must be acknowledged by regenerating
the baseline (--write-baseline) in the same change.

Known over-counts: mutually exclusive macro definitions are counted separately;
inactive #if branches count; and a non-launch <<< token can resemble a kernel
launch. Known under-counts: malformed/unbalanced syntax is skipped; discarded
CUDA status detection only covers conservative bare runtime-call statements
(not lowercase CUDA driver APIs or larger expressions); an unrelated nearby
CUDA check can satisfy the launch window; and result-in-cu only recognizes
.cu/.cuh extensions, not CMake LANGUAGE CUDA overrides. The intentional
cudaGetLastError/cudaPeekAtLastError carve-out is never reported.

"""


def _build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description=(
            "Compute the Phase 0 error-debt census using conservative lexical/regex "
            "heuristics (not an AST)."
        ),
        epilog=_rules_help(),
        formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter,
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--root",
        type=Path,
        default=DEFAULT_ROOT,
        metavar="DIR",
        help=f"source tree to scan (default: {DEFAULT_ROOT})",
    )
    mode = parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group()
    mode.add_argument(
        "--baseline",
        type=Path,
        metavar="FILE",
        help=(
            "fail on new locations and on per-(rule,file) count decreases vs the "
            "location baseline (regenerate the baseline in the same change to "
            "acknowledge a reduction)"
        ),
    )
    mode.add_argument(
        "--write-baseline",
        type=Path,
        metavar="FILE",
        help="write a pretty location-level baseline",
    )
    mode.add_argument(
        "--list",
        dest="list_rule",
        metavar="RULE_ID",
        help="list current FILE:LINE hits for one rule",
    )
    return parser


def main(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> int:
    args = _build_parser().parse_args(argv)

    if args.list_rule is not None and args.list_rule not in RULE_BY_ID:
        print(f"error: unknown rule id: {args.list_rule}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2

    try:
        hits = scan(args.root)
    except OSError as error:
        print(f"error: unable to scan '{args.root}': {error}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2

    if args.write_baseline is not None:
        baseline = baseline_locations(hits)
        try:
            args.write_baseline.write_text(
                json.dumps(baseline, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n",
                encoding="utf-8",
            )
        except OSError as error:
            print(
                f"error: cannot write baseline '{args.write_baseline}': {error}",
                file=sys.stderr,
            )
            return 2

        totals = census_summary(hits)["totals"]
        print(f"wrote baseline: {args.write_baseline}", file=sys.stderr)
        for rule in RULES:
            print(f"{rule.rule_id}: {totals[rule.rule_id]}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 0

    if args.baseline is not None:
        try:
            baseline = _load_baseline(args.baseline)
        except ValueError as error:
            print(f"error: {error}", file=sys.stderr)
            return 2

        new_hits = _new_violations(hits, baseline)
        stale = _stale_decreases(hits, baseline)
        for hit in new_hits:
            print(f"{hit.rule}\t{hit.module}\t{hit.location}")
        for rule, module, file, baseline_count, current_count in stale:
            print(f"stale-baseline\t{rule}\t{module}\t{file}\t{baseline_count}->{current_count}")
        if stale:
            print(
                "error: per-(rule,file) counts decreased vs the baseline; an honest fix "
                "and a matcher-evading refactor look identical here. If the reduction is "
                f"intentional, regenerate in the same change: --write-baseline {args.baseline}",
                file=sys.stderr,
            )
        if new_hits or stale:
            return 1
        print("no new error-debt violations", file=sys.stderr)
        return 0

    if args.list_rule is not None:
        selected = sorted(
            (hit for hit in hits if hit.rule == args.list_rule),
            key=lambda hit: (hit.file, hit.line),
        )
        for hit in selected:
            print(hit.location)
        return 0

    print(json.dumps(census_summary(hits), indent=2, sort_keys=True))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
```

### tools/generate_keymap_defaults.py

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build historical default keymaps from their original C++ implementations.

Run --check in CI. Before changing defaults, bump PROFILE_VERSION and run
python3 tools/generate_keymap_defaults.py --record-previous HEAD.
"""
import argparse, base64, json, re, subprocess, tempfile, zlib
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
OUTPUT = ROOT / "src/visualizer/input/generated_keymap_defaults.hpp"
SOURCE_ROWS = '''
v0.5.0 v0.5.0
v0.5.1 v0.5.1
v0.5.2 v0.5.2
v0.5.3 v0.5.3
v0.5.4 v0.5.4
v2 a14554398
v3 3d9772412

v5 0cb2f99d8

v28 7fb6b317ba8b
v26_group 95770df08
v29 27dd365aa
v29_master 11926fd5f2f8968514e1378f2e1212ffe25a6cfb
v30 11926fd5f2f8968514e1378f2e1212ffe25a6cfb
v31 2f4f139745259857dbfca51f644b55d66705cdaf
v32 6537262420834b1a7ff1a705cc2d6aa39b96c490
v33 28290f8891d96cb23fd50593ec1d4f5c594e81f8
v34 f3a2b375b7162e1eff44f6413b46f32854b5386a
v35 c9bbcaca31935de68e96dd5c008ad379ac86d4ff
v36 32e64ebd10458cac81f012579e83f13d2f60b4f9
v37 e8ed4816389d1b8e5b205e88802730e15db587ae
'''
SOURCES = dict(row.split() for row in SOURCE_ROWS.splitlines() if row.strip())
VERSION_OVERRIDES = {"v30": 30}  # v30 changed storage only; defaults match v29_master.
DECODER = 'inline std::string decodeHistoricalKeymapDefaults() {\n    constexpr std::string_view alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/";\n    std::vector<unsigned char> compressed;\n    unsigned int accumulator = 0;\n    int bits = 0;\n    for (const char ch : kHistoricalKeymapDefaultsBase64) {\n        if (ch == \'=\') break;\n        const auto value = alphabet.find(ch);\n        if (value == std::string_view::npos) continue;\n        accumulator = (accumulator << 6) | static_cast<unsigned int>(value);\n        bits += 6;\n        if (bits >= 8) {\n            bits -= 8;\n            compressed.push_back(static_cast<unsigned char>((accumulator >> bits) & 0xff));\n            accumulator &= (1u << bits) - 1u;\n        }\n    }\n    z_stream stream{};\n    stream.next_in = compressed.data();\n    stream.avail_in = static_cast<uInt>(compressed.size());\n    if (inflateInit(&stream) != Z_OK)\n        throw std::runtime_error("Could not initialize historical keymap decoder");\n    std::string result;\n    std::vector<char> chunk(4096);\n    int status = Z_OK;\n    while (status == Z_OK) {\n        stream.next_out = reinterpret_cast<Bytef*>(chunk.data());\n        stream.avail_out = static_cast<uInt>(chunk.size());\n        status = inflate(&stream, Z_NO_FLUSH);\n        result.append(chunk.data(), chunk.size() - stream.avail_out);\n    }\n    inflateEnd(&stream);\n    if (status != Z_STREAM_END)\n        throw std::runtime_error("Could not decode historical keymap defaults");\n    return result;\n}\ninline const nlohmann::json& historicalKeymapDefaults() {\n    static const nlohmann::json table = nlohmann::json::parse(decodeHistoricalKeymapDefaults());\n    return table;\n}\n// clang-format on\n'

def show(ref, path):
    if ref == "WORKTREE": return (ROOT / path).read_text()
    return subprocess.check_output(["git", "show", f"{ref}:{path}"], cwd=ROOT, text=True, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)

def block(source, marker):
    start, opening, depth = source.index(marker), source.index("{", source.index(marker)), 0
    for i in range(opening, len(source)):
        depth += (source[i] == "{") - (source[i] == "}")
        if depth == 0: return source[start:i + 1]
    raise ValueError(marker)

def enum_values(header, kind):
    body = block(header, f"enum class {kind}").split("{", 1)[1].rsplit("}", 1)[0]
    body = re.sub(r"//[^\n]*|/\*.*?\*/", "", body, flags=re.S)
    result, number = {}, -1
    for entry in body.split(","):
        if not (entry := entry.strip()): continue
        match = re.fullmatch(r"(\w+)(?:\s*=\s*(\d+))?", entry)
        if not match: raise ValueError(f"unsupported {kind} entry: {entry}")
        number = int(match.group(2)) if match.group(2) else number + 1
        result[number] = match.group(1)
    return result

CPP = r'''#include <array>
#include <iostream>
#include <optional>
#include <string>
#include <variant>
#include <vector>
#include "input/key_codes.hpp"
namespace lfs::vis::input { using namespace std;
ENUMS
enum Modifier { MODIFIER_NONE=KEYMOD_NONE, MODIFIER_SHIFT=KEYMOD_SHIFT, MODIFIER_CTRL=KEYMOD_CTRL, MODIFIER_ALT=KEYMOD_ALT, MODIFIER_SUPER=KEYMOD_SUPER };
enum class MouseButton { LEFT=0, RIGHT=1, MIDDLE=2 };
struct KeyTrigger { int key; int modifiers=0; bool on_repeat=false; };
struct MouseButtonTrigger { MouseButton button; int modifiers=0; bool double_click=false; };
struct MouseScrollTrigger { int modifiers=0; optional<int> chord_key={}; };
struct MouseDragTrigger { MouseButton button; int modifiers=0; optional<int> chord_key={}; };
using InputTrigger=variant<KeyTrigger,MouseButtonTrigger,MouseScrollTrigger,MouseDragTrigger>;
struct Binding { ToolMode mode; InputTrigger trigger; Action action; string description; };
struct Profile { string name, description; vector<Binding> bindings; };
struct InputBindings { static Profile createDefaultProfile(); };
ARRAYS
ACTION_NAME
FUNCTION
}
int main() { using namespace lfs::vis::input; for (const auto& b : InputBindings::createDefaultProfile().bindings) { cout << int(b.mode) << '\t' << int(b.action) << '\t' << b.description << '\t'; visit([](const auto& t) { using T=decay_t<decltype(t)>; if constexpr(is_same_v<T,KeyTrigger>) cout << "key\t" << t.key << '\t' << t.modifiers << '\t' << t.on_repeat; else if constexpr(is_same_v<T,MouseButtonTrigger>) cout << "mouse_button\t" << int(t.button) << '\t' << t.modifiers << '\t' << t.double_click; else if constexpr(is_same_v<T,MouseScrollTrigger>) cout << "scroll\t" << t.modifiers << '\t' << t.chord_key.value_or(-1); else cout << "drag\t" << int(t.button) << '\t' << t.modifiers << '\t' << t.chord_key.value_or(-1); }, b.trigger); cout << '\n'; } }
'''

def generate(ref):
    source = show(ref, "src/visualizer/input/input_bindings.cpp")
    header = show(ref, "src/visualizer/input/input_bindings.hpp")
    try: key_codes = show(ref, "src/visualizer/input/key_codes.hpp")
    except subprocess.CalledProcessError: key_codes = (ROOT / "src/visualizer/input/key_codes.hpp").read_text()
    actions = enum_values(header, "Action")
    version = int(re.search(r"PROFILE_VERSION\s*=\s*(\d+)", source).group(1))
    arrays = []
    before_defaults = source[:source.index("Profile InputBindings::createDefaultProfile()")]
    for name in ("ALL_MODES", "NODE_PICK_MODES", "DELETE_NODE_MODES", "DELETE_GAUSSIANS_MODES"):
        match = re.search(r"constexpr (?:std::array<ToolMode,\s*\d+>|ToolMode)\s+" + name + r"(?:\[\])?\s*=\s*\{.*?\};", before_defaults, re.S)
        if match: arrays.append(match.group(0))
    cpp = CPP.replace("ENUMS", "\n".join(block(header, f"enum class {kind}") + ";" for kind in ("ToolMode", "Action")))
    cpp = cpp.replace("ARRAYS", "\n".join(arrays)).replace("ACTION_NAME", block(source, "std::string getActionName("))
    cpp = cpp.replace("FUNCTION", block(source, "Profile InputBindings::createDefaultProfile()")).replace("GLFW_KEY_", "KEY_")
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        path = Path(tmp) / "defaults.cpp"; path.write_text(cpp)
        (Path(tmp) / "input").mkdir(); (Path(tmp) / "input/key_codes.hpp").write_text(key_codes)
        exe = Path(tmp) / "defaults"
        subprocess.run(["c++", "-std=c++20", "-I", tmp, "-I", str(ROOT / "src/visualizer"), str(path), "-o", str(exe)], check=True)
        rows = subprocess.check_output([str(exe)], text=True)
    bindings = []
    for row in rows.splitlines():
        mode, action, desc, kind, *args = row.split("\t")
        item = dict(mode=int(mode), action=int(action), action_symbol=actions[int(action)], description=desc, trigger_type=kind)
        if kind == "key": item.update(key=int(args[0]), modifiers=int(args[1]), on_repeat=bool(int(args[2])))
        elif kind == "mouse_button": item.update(button=int(args[0]), modifiers=int(args[1]), double_click=bool(int(args[2])))
        elif kind == "scroll":
            item["modifiers"] = int(args[0])
            if int(args[1]) >= 0: item["chord_key"] = int(args[1])
        else:
            item.update(button=int(args[0]), modifiers=int(args[1]))
            if int(args[2]) >= 0: item["chord_key"] = int(args[2])
        bindings.append(item)
    return dict(name="Default", version=version, source=ref,
                actions={str(k): v for k, v in actions.items()}, bindings=bindings)

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(); parser.add_argument("--check", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--record-previous", metavar="REF", help="record defaults before a profile version bump")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.record_previous:
        ref = subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", args.record_previous], cwd=ROOT, text=True).strip()
        previous, current = generate(ref), generate("WORKTREE")
        if current["version"] != previous["version"] + 1: raise SystemExit("Bump PROFILE_VERSION by one before recording defaults")
        name = f'v{previous["version"]}'
        if name in SOURCES and SOURCES[name] != ref: raise SystemExit(f"{name} is already recorded from a different revision")
        if name not in SOURCES:
            script = Path(__file__); source = script.read_text(); marker = "\n'''\nSOURCES = dict"
            if marker not in source: raise SystemExit("Could not update historical source list")
            source = source.replace(marker, f"\n{name} {ref}" + marker, 1)
            script.write_text(source)
            SOURCES[name] = ref
    profiles, data, indices = [], [], {}
    for name, ref in SOURCES.items():
        item = generate(ref)
        if name in VERSION_OVERRIDES:
            if item["version"] + 1 != VERSION_OVERRIDES[name]: raise SystemExit(f"invalid unchanged-default alias: {name}")
            item["version"] = VERSION_OVERRIDES[name]
        canonical = json.dumps({"actions": item["actions"], "bindings": item["bindings"]}, separators=(",", ":"), sort_keys=True)
        index = indices.get(canonical)
        if index is None: index = len(data); indices[canonical] = index; data.append(json.loads(canonical))
        profiles.append(dict(version=item["version"], name=name, data=index)); print(f"{name}: profile version {item['version']}, table {index}")
    packed = base64.b64encode(zlib.compress(json.dumps(dict(profiles=profiles, data=data), separators=(",", ":"), sort_keys=True).encode(), 9)).decode("ascii")
    chunks = [packed[i:i + 992] for i in range(0, len(packed), 992)]
    lines = ["// Generated by tools/generate_keymap_defaults.py; do not edit.\n// clang-format off\n", "#pragma once\n#include <array>\n#include <stdexcept>\n#include <string>\n#include <string_view>\n#include <utility>\n#include <vector>\n#include <nlohmann/json.hpp>\n#include <zlib.h>\n", "namespace lfs::vis::input {\n", f"inline constexpr int kLatestHistoricalProfileVersion = {max(p['version'] for p in profiles)};\n", "inline constexpr std::string_view kHistoricalKeymapDefaultsBase64 =\n"]
    lines.extend(f'    "{chunk}"\n' for chunk in chunks); lines.append("    ;\n")
    lines.append(DECODER.replace('\n// clang-format on\n', '\n    // clang-format on\n'))
    symbols = enum_values((ROOT / "src/visualizer/input/input_bindings.hpp").read_text(), "Action")
    lines.append(f"    inline constexpr std::array<std::pair<std::string_view, int>, {len(symbols)}> kCurrentActionSymbols = {{{{\n")
    lines.extend(f'        {{"{symbol}", static_cast<int>(Action::{symbol})}},\n' for symbol in symbols.values())
    lines.append("    }};\n} // namespace lfs::vis::input\n"); generated = "".join(lines)
    if args.check:
        if not OUTPUT.exists() or OUTPUT.read_text() != generated: raise SystemExit(f"stale keymap defaults: {OUTPUT}")
    else: OUTPUT.write_text(generated)
    current = generate("WORKTREE")
    bindings = [{k:v for k,v in b.items() if k != "action_symbol"} for b in current["bindings"]]
    baseline = ROOT / f'tests/data/keymap_contract/current_v{current["version"]}.digest'; baseline.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    digest = 14695981039346656037
    for byte in json.dumps(bindings, separators=(",", ":"), sort_keys=True).encode("utf-8"):
        digest = ((digest ^ byte) * 1099511628211) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
    content = f'version {current["version"]}\nfnv1a64 {digest:016x}\n'; print(f'current defaults v{current["version"]} fnv1a64: {digest:016x}')
    if args.check:
        if not baseline.exists() or baseline.read_text() != content:
            raise SystemExit("Default bindings changed without recording the previous version. Bump PROFILE_VERSION, then run: python3 tools/generate_keymap_defaults.py --record-previous HEAD")
    else: baseline.write_text(content)

if __name__ == "__main__": main()

### tools/generate_keymap_layouts.py
```
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Regenerate checked-in XKB keysyms; run with setxkbmap, xkbcomp, libxkbcommon."""
import argparse, ctypes, json, re, subprocess, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
OUTPUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / 'tests/data/keymap_layouts'
POSITIONS = {'TLDE':53, 'AE11':45, 'AE12':46, 'AD11':47, 'AD12':48, 'AC10':51, 'AC11':52,
             'AB08':54, 'AB09':55, 'AB10':56, 'BKSL':49, 'LSGT':100, 'SPCE':44}
POSITIONS.update({f'AE{i:02d}':29+i for i in range(1,11)})
POSITIONS.update(dict(zip((f'AD{i:02d}' for i in range(1,11)), [20,26,8,21,23,28,24,12,18,19])))
POSITIONS.update(dict(zip((f'AC{i:02d}' for i in range(1,10)), [4,22,7,9,10,11,13,14,15])))
POSITIONS.update(dict(zip((f'AB{i:02d}' for i in range(1,8)), [29,27,6,25,5,17,16])))
LAYOUTS = [('us','us',''),('gb','gb',''),('de','de',''),('ch','ch',''),('fr','fr',''),('be','be',''),('es','es',''),('it','it',''),('pt','pt',''),('se','se',''),('no','no',''),('dk','dk',''),('pl','pl',''),('cz','cz',''),('us-dvorak','us','dvorak'),('us-colemak','us','colemak'),('ru','ru',''),('ua','ua',''),('jp','jp','')]
lib = ctypes.CDLL('libxkbcommon.so.0')
lib.xkb_keysym_from_name.argtypes = [ctypes.c_char_p, ctypes.c_int]; lib.xkb_keysym_from_name.restype = ctypes.c_uint32
lib.xkb_keysym_to_utf32.argtypes = [ctypes.c_uint32]; lib.xkb_keysym_to_utf32.restype = ctypes.c_uint32

def unicode_symbol(name):
    if name == 'NoSymbol': return 0
    return int(lib.xkb_keysym_to_utf32(lib.xkb_keysym_from_name(name.encode(), 0)))

def generate(label, layout, variant):
    cmd = ['setxkbmap','-rules','evdev','-model','pc105','-layout',layout]
    if variant: cmd += ['-variant',variant]
    spec = subprocess.check_output(cmd + ['-print'], text=True)
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
        p = Path(d); (p/'spec.xkb').write_text(spec)
        subprocess.run(['xkbcomp','-xkb',str(p/'spec.xkb'),str(p/'expanded.xkb')], check=True, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
        source = (p/'expanded.xkb').read_text()
    rows = []
    for match in re.finditer(r'key\s+<(\w+)>\s*\{(.*?)\};', source, re.S):
        pos, body = match.groups()
        if pos not in POSITIONS: continue
        sym = re.search(r'symbols\[Group1\]\s*=\s*\[([^]]+)\]', body) or re.search(r'\[([^]]+)\]', body)
        if not sym: continue
        names = [v.strip() for v in sym.group(1).split(',')]
        shifted = names[1] if len(names) > 1 else names[0]
        rows.append(dict(position=pos, scancode=POSITIONS[pos], unshifted=unicode_symbol(names[0]), shifted=unicode_symbol(shifted), unshifted_name=names[0], shifted_name=shifted))
    return dict(layout=label, xkb_layout=layout, xkb_variant=variant, rows=sorted(rows, key=lambda r:r['scancode']))

if __name__ == '__main__':
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__); parser.add_argument('--check', action='store_true'); args = parser.parse_args()
    OUTPUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for layout in LAYOUTS:
        data = generate(*layout)
        if len(data['rows']) != len(POSITIONS): raise SystemExit(f'{layout[0]}: expected {len(POSITIONS)} positions, got {len(data["rows"])}')
        path = OUTPUT / f'{layout[0]}.json'; content = json.dumps(data, separators=(',',':'), ensure_ascii=False)+'\n'
        if args.check and (not path.exists() or path.read_text() != content): raise SystemExit(f'Stale layout table: {path}; run python3 tools/generate_keymap_layouts.py')
        if not args.check: path.write_text(content)
        print(f'{layout[0]}: {len(data["rows"])} keys')
```

### tools/generate_moge2_fixture.py
```
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate the small ONNX-reference fixture used by the native MoGe-2 tests.

The test feeds a 1x3x70x70 RGB image made directly from the same CHW formula
as ``make_test_image`` in ``tests/test_moge2.cpp`` and asks the model for 400
tokens.  This script runs the shipped ONNX graph in ONNX Runtime, promotes
the named intermediate tensors to graph outputs, and writes sampled values for
each tap plus the complete postprocessed ``normal`` output.

Usage (from the repository root)::

    python3 tools/generate_moge2_fixture.py

Use ``--onnx``, ``--height``, ``--width``, ``--num-tokens``, ``--samples``,
and ``--output`` to override the defaults.  The fixture intentionally stores
only sampled values for intermediate/output taps; ``full.normal.values`` is
the sole complete array because the C++ parity test checks its Linf error.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import onnx
import onnxruntime as ort


# Native tap name -> exact ONNX value carrying the same layout and semantic
# stage.  The native implementation uses the post-Reshape/Transpose patch
# tokens, terminal block residual adds, and the final tensors in each head.
TAP_TO_ONNX = {
    "patch_embed": "/encoder/patch_embed/Transpose_output_0",
    **{
        f"block{i}": f"/encoder/blocks.{i}/Add_1_output_0"
        for i in range(12)
    },
    "encoder_feat": "/encoder/ReduceSum_output_0",
    "neck0": "/neck/input_blocks.0/Conv_output_0",
    "neck1": "/neck/res_blocks.1/res_blocks.1.0/Add_output_0",
    "neck2": "/neck/res_blocks.2/res_blocks.2.0/Add_output_0",
    "neck3": "/neck/res_blocks.3/res_blocks.3.0/Add_output_0",
    "neck4": "/neck/Add_3_output_0",
    "points_head": "/points_head/output_blocks.4/Conv_output_0",
    "normal_head": "/normal_head/output_blocks.4/Conv_output_0",
    "mask_head": "/mask_head/output_blocks.4/Conv_output_0",
    "points": "points",
    "normal": "normal",
    "mask": "mask",
    "metric_scale": "metric_scale",
}


def make_test_image(height: int, width: int) -> np.ndarray:
    """Return the exact float32 NCHW image constructed by the C++ test."""

    image = np.empty((1, 3, height, width), dtype=np.float32)
    plane = height * width
    # Keep the scalar casts explicit: C++ casts numerator and denominator to
    # float before division, then stores the result in its float vector.
    for y in range(height):
        for x in range(width):
            i = y * width + x
            image.flat[i] = np.float32(
                np.float32(x) / np.float32(max(width - 1, 1))
            )
            image.flat[plane + i] = np.float32(
                np.float32(y) / np.float32(max(height - 1, 1))
            )
            image.flat[2 * plane + i] = np.float32(
                np.float32(x + y) / np.float32(max(width + height - 2, 1))
            )
    return image


def promote_outputs(model: onnx.ModelProto, names: list[str]) -> None:
    """Add intermediate values to graph outputs without changing the file."""

    produced = {output for node in model.graph.node for output in node.output}
    graph_outputs = {output.name for output in model.graph.output}
    missing = [name for name in names if name not in produced and name not in graph_outputs]
    if missing:
        raise RuntimeError("ONNX values are not produced by the graph: " + ", ".join(missing))
    for name in names:
        if name not in graph_outputs:
            model.graph.output.append(
                onnx.helper.make_tensor_value_info(name, onnx.TensorProto.FLOAT, None)
            )
            graph_outputs.add(name)


def sampled(array: np.ndarray, count: int) -> dict[str, object]:
    """Encode evenly distributed flat samples in the C++ fixture schema."""

    flat = np.asarray(array, dtype=np.float32).reshape(-1)
    if not np.isfinite(flat).all():
        raise RuntimeError("non-finite value in ONNX output with shape " + str(array.shape))
    sample_count = min(count, flat.size)
    indices = np.linspace(0, flat.size - 1, sample_count, dtype=np.int64)
    indices = np.unique(indices)
    return {
        "shape": [int(dimension) for dimension in array.shape],
        "indices": [int(index) for index in indices],
        "values": [float(flat[index]) for index in indices],
    }


def parse_args() -> argparse.Namespace:
    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
    lane = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    home = Path.home()
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument(
        "--onnx",
        type=Path,
        default=home / ".lichtfeld/onnx/moge-2-vitb-normal.onnx",
        help="MoGe-2 ViT-B ONNX reference (default: %(default)s)",
    )
    parser.add_argument("--height", type=int, default=70)
    parser.add_argument("--width", type=int, default=70)
    parser.add_argument("--num-tokens", type=int, default=400)
    parser.add_argument("--samples", type=int, default=16)
    parser.add_argument(
        "--output",
        type=Path,
        default=lane / "moge2_ref_fixture.json",
        help="fixture JSON output (default: %(default)s)",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--threads",
        type=int,
        default=1,
        help="ORT intra-op threads (default: %(default)s for reproducibility)",
    )
    parser.set_defaults(repo_root=root)
    return parser.parse_args()


def main() -> int:
    args = parse_args()
    if args.height < 1 or args.width < 1 or args.num_tokens < 1 or args.samples < 1:
        raise SystemExit("height, width, num-tokens, and samples must be positive")
    if not args.onnx.is_file():
        raise SystemExit(f"ONNX model not found: {args.onnx}")

    image = make_test_image(args.height, args.width)
    model = onnx.load(str(args.onnx), load_external_data=False)
    promote_outputs(model, list(TAP_TO_ONNX.values()))
    session_options = ort.SessionOptions()
    if args.threads > 0:
        session_options.intra_op_num_threads = args.threads
    session = ort.InferenceSession(
        model.SerializeToString(), session_options, providers=["CPUExecutionProvider"]
    )
    feed = {"image": image, "num_tokens": np.asarray(args.num_tokens, dtype=np.int64)}
    output_names = [output.name for output in session.get_outputs()]
    outputs = dict(zip(output_names, session.run(None, feed)))

    absent = [name for name in TAP_TO_ONNX.values() if name not in outputs]
    if absent:
        raise RuntimeError("promoted ONNX outputs missing from ORT result: " + ", ".join(absent))

    nodes = {}
    for tap, onnx_name in TAP_TO_ONNX.items():
        nodes[tap] = sampled(outputs[onnx_name], args.samples)
    normal = np.asarray(outputs["normal"], dtype=np.float32)
    if not np.isfinite(normal).all():
        raise RuntimeError("non-finite value in complete normal output")

    payload = {
        "input_shape": [1, 3, args.height, args.width],
        "num_tokens": args.num_tokens,
        "nodes": nodes,
        "full": {
            "normal": {
                "shape": [int(dimension) for dimension in normal.shape],
                "values": [float(value) for value in normal.reshape(-1)],
            }
        },
    }
    args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    args.output.write_text(json.dumps(payload, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    size = args.output.stat().st_size
    if size >= 2 * 1024 * 1024:
        raise RuntimeError(f"fixture is too large: {size} bytes")
    print(f"wrote {args.output} ({size} bytes)")
    print(f"input shape={payload['input_shape']} num_tokens={args.num_tokens}")
    for tap, node in nodes.items():
        print(f"{tap}: {node['shape']} <- {TAP_TO_ONNX[tap]}")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
```

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 LichtFeld Studio Authors
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
"""Regenerate Tessle Leafjaw's sprites from the selected CSS concept (requires Pillow)."""
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw

OUTPUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "src/visualizer/gui/assets/icon/tessle"
SCALE = 8
SIZE = 28
SKIN, SHADE, INK, TOOTH = "#70d6ad", "#459c7d", "#193b34", "#fff2d2"


def canvas():
    return Image.new("RGBA", (SIZE * SCALE, SIZE * SCALE))


def box(values):
    return tuple(round(v * SCALE) for v in values)


def save(image, name, size=(56, 56)):
    image.resize(size, Image.Resampling.LANCZOS).save(OUTPUT / f"{name}.png")


def leaf_shape(draw, bounds, color):
    # Opposite rounded corners form the same leaf silhouette as the CSS concept.
    x, y, right, bottom = bounds
    points = []
    for start, control, end in (((right, y), (x, y), (x, bottom)),
                                ((x, bottom), (right, bottom), (right, y))):
        for step in range(21):
            t = step / 20
            points.append(box(tuple((1 - t) ** 2 * a + 2 * (1 - t) * t * b + t ** 2 * c
                                    for a, b, c in zip(start, control, end))))
    draw.polygon(points, fill=color)


def creature(openness):
    image = canvas()
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(image)
    leaf_shape(draw, (0, 13, 10, 21), SHADE)
    for x in (9, 19):
        draw.rounded_rectangle(box((x, 23, x + 5, 27)), radius=2 * SCALE, fill=SHADE)
    for x, y, color, angle in ((8, 0, SHADE, 20), (13, 1, SKIN, -12)):
        ear = canvas()
        leaf_shape(ImageDraw.Draw(ear), (x, y, x + 6, y + 10), color)
        image.alpha_composite(ear.rotate(angle, Image.Resampling.BICUBIC, center=box((x + 3, y + 5))))
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(image)
    draw.rounded_rectangle(box((7, 16, 27, 23)), radius=2 * SCALE, fill=INK)

    jaw = canvas()
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(jaw)
    top = 17 if openness == 0 else 18
    draw.rounded_rectangle(box((6, top, 26, top + 5)), radius=3 * SCALE, fill=SHADE)
    draw.rectangle(box((6, top, 26, top + 2)), fill=SHADE)
    draw.rectangle(box((18, top - 2, 21, top + 1)), fill=TOOTH)
    image.alpha_composite(jaw.rotate(-21 * openness, Image.Resampling.BICUBIC, center=box((8, top))))

    upper = canvas()
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(upper)
    draw.rounded_rectangle(box((5, 5, 27, 19)), radius=8 * SCALE, fill=SKIN)
    draw.rounded_rectangle(box((5, 12, 27, 19)), radius=2 * SCALE, fill=SKIN)
    draw.ellipse(box((15, 8, 19, 12)), fill=INK)
    draw.rounded_rectangle(box((22, 17, 25, 20)), radius=SCALE // 2, fill=TOOTH)
    image.alpha_composite(upper.rotate(4 * openness, Image.Resampling.BICUBIC, center=box((5, 19))))
    return image


def generate():
    OUTPUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for name, openness in (("closed", 0), ("half", 0.5), ("open", 1)):
        save(creature(openness), name)

    image = Image.new("RGBA", (6 * SCALE, 4 * SCALE))
    leaf_shape(ImageDraw.Draw(image), (0, 0, 6, 4), "#b1d2ad")
    save(image, "leaf", (48, 32))

    # Preserve the checkpoint fruit and its existing editing hit target.
    image = Image.new("RGBA", (14 * SCALE, 14 * SCALE))
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(image)
    draw.line([box((3.5, 8)), box((8, 1)), box((10.5, 7.5))], fill="#6bd05a", width=SCALE)
    draw.ellipse(box((8, 0.3, 12.5, 2.4)), fill="#8fe471")
    for x, y in ((0.8, 7.0), (7.2, 6.0)):
        draw.ellipse(box((x, y, x + 5.5, y + 5.8)), fill="#a81739")
        draw.ellipse(box((x, y, x + 5.0, y + 4.8)), fill="#ff3655")
        draw.ellipse(box((x + 1, y + 0.7, x + 2.3, y + 1.9)), fill="#ffb2b9")
    save(image, "cherries")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    generate()

### tools/generate_third_party_licenses.py
```
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate the release-specific third-party notices from installed inputs."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import re
import subprocess
import sys
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

NVIDIA_CUDA_RUNTIME_COMPONENTS = {
    "cudart": ("NVIDIA CUDA Runtime", "CUDA Runtime"),
    "curand": ("NVIDIA CUDA Random Number Generation", "CUDA Random Number Generation Library"),
    "nvjpeg": ("NVIDIA JPEG Library", "NVIDIA JPEG Library"),
    "nvrtc": ("NVIDIA Runtime Compilation Library", "NVIDIA Runtime Compilation Library"),
    "nvjitlink": ("NVIDIA JIT Linking Library", "NVIDIA JIT Linking Library"),
    "nvtoolsext": ("NVIDIA Tools Extension Library", "NVIDIA Tools Extension Library"),
}


def read_text(path: Path) -> str:
    try:
        return path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").strip()
    except OSError:
        return ""


def copyright_lines(text: str) -> str:
    rows = []
    for line in text.splitlines():
        value = line.strip()
        lower = value.lower()
        if "[yyyy]" in lower or "<year>" in lower:
            continue
        if re.match(r"(?i)^SPDX-FileCopyrightText:", value):
            rows.append(value)
        elif re.match(r"(?i)^copyright\b|^©", value) and not any(part in lower for part in ("copyright notice", "copyright law", "copyright holder", "copyright owner", "copyright license")):
            rows.append(value)
    return "; ".join(dict.fromkeys(rows))


def license_id_from_text(text: str, fallback: str) -> str:
    first = "\n".join(text.splitlines()[:30])
    label = re.match(r"(?i)^\s*(?:license|licensing)\s*[:=-]\s*(.+)$", text.strip())
    if label:
        normalized = label.group(1).strip().lower()
        label_ids = {"mit": "MIT", "mit license": "MIT", "apache-2.0": "Apache-2.0", "bsd-2-clause": "BSD-2-Clause", "bsd-3-clause": "BSD-3-Clause", "ofl-1.1": "OFL-1.1", "mpl-2.0": "MPL-2.0", "gpl-2.0-or-later": "GPL-2.0-or-later", "gpl-3.0-or-later": "GPL-3.0-or-later", "lgpl-2.1-or-later": "LGPL-2.1-or-later"}
        if normalized in label_ids:
            return label_ids[normalized]
    patterns = [
        (r"(?i)Apache License(?:,? Version)?\s*2\.0|Apache-2\.0", "Apache-2.0"),
        (r"(?i)MIT License", "MIT"),
        (r"(?i)BSD 3-Clause|BSD-3-Clause", "BSD-3-Clause"),
        (r"(?i)BSD 2-Clause|BSD-2-Clause", "BSD-2-Clause"),
        (r"(?i)SIL OPEN FONT LICENSE", "OFL-1.1"),
        (r"(?i)Mozilla Public License(?:,? Version)?\s*2\.0", "MPL-2.0"),
        (r"(?i)GNU LESSER GENERAL PUBLIC LICENSE\s+Version 2\.1", "LGPL-2.1-or-later"),
        (r"(?i)GNU GENERAL PUBLIC LICENSE\s+Version 3", "GPL-3.0-or-later"),
        (r"(?i)GNU GENERAL PUBLIC LICENSE\s+Version 2", "GPL-2.0-or-later"),
        (r"(?i)Boost Software License", "BSL-1.0"),
        (r"(?i)zlib License", "Zlib"),
    ]
    return next((spdx for pattern, spdx in patterns if re.search(pattern, first)), fallback)


def acknowledgement_components(file: Path, source_root: Path, revision: str) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
    components = []
    sections = re.split(r"(?m)^={12,}\s*$", read_text(file))
    for section in sections:
        section = section.strip()
        lines = [line.strip() for line in section.splitlines() if line.strip()]
        if not lines or not re.search(r"https?://", lines[0]):
            continue
        name = lines[0].split("(", 1)[0].strip()
        if not name:
            continue
        if re.search(r"(?i)Boost Software License", section):
            license_id = "BSL-1.0"
        else:
            license_id = license_id_from_text(section, "LicenseRef-nvImageCodec-acknowledgement")
            if license_id.startswith("LicenseRef-") and "Redistribution and use" in section:
                license_id = "BSD-3-Clause" if "Neither the name" in section else "BSD-2-Clause"
        components.append({"name": f"nvImageCodec acknowledgement: {name}", "version": f"not versioned separately (nvImageCodec revision {revision})", "license": license_id, "copyright": copyright_lines(section) or f"Copyright notice is included in the acknowledgement for {name}.", "text": section})
    return components


def installed_ports(triplet_dir: Path, vcpkg_root: Path | None = None) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
    result = []
    for metadata in sorted((triplet_dir / "share").glob("*/vcpkg.spdx.json")):
        data = json.loads(metadata.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        package = next((p for p in data.get("packages", []) if p.get("SPDXID") == "SPDXRef-port"), {})
        name = package.get("name", metadata.parent.name)
        version = package.get("versionInfo", "unknown")
        license_id = package.get("licenseConcluded") or package.get("licenseDeclared") or "NOASSERTION"
        copyright = package.get("copyrightText", "NOASSERTION")
        text = read_text(metadata.parent / "copyright")
        license_texts = [text] if text else []
        if vcpkg_root:
            references = re.findall(r"(?i)([A-Za-z0-9_./+-]*(?:LICENSE|COPYING|NOTICE|PATENTS)[A-Za-z0-9_.+-]*)", text)
            source_root = vcpkg_root / "buildtrees" / name / "src"
            for reference in references:
                basename = Path(reference).name
                candidates = [metadata.parent / reference]
                if source_root.exists():
                    candidates.extend(source_root.glob(f"**/{basename}"))
                for candidate in candidates:
                    body = read_text(candidate)
                    if body and body not in license_texts:
                        license_texts.append(body)
        if license_id in ("NOASSERTION", "LicenseRef-vcpkg-null"):
            # vcpkg's SPDX metadata may leave the expression empty while its
            # installed copyright file still contains the source license.
            license_id = license_id_from_text(text, f"LicenseRef-{name}")
        is_license_preamble = re.match(r"(?i)^\s*(?:GNU (?:LESSER )?GENERAL PUBLIC LICENSE|MIT License|Apache License|BSD [23]-Clause License)", text)
        actual_copyrights = "" if is_license_preamble else copyright_lines(text)
        if actual_copyrights:
            copyright = actual_copyrights
        elif copyright in ("NOASSERTION", "NONE", "") or "copyright information" in copyright.lower():
            copyright = "Copyright statement is included in the bundled vcpkg copyright text."
        result.append({"name": name, "version": version, "license": license_id, "copyright": copyright, "text": "\n\n".join(license_texts)})
    return result


def vendored_components(root: Path, source_root: Path) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
    result = []
    revisions: dict[str, str] = {}
    for file in sorted(root.rglob("*")):
        if not file.is_file():
            continue
        is_readme = file.name.lower() in {"readme", "readme.md", "readme.txt"}
        is_acknowledgements = "acknowledg" in file.name.lower()
        is_license_doc = any(token in file.name.lower() for token in ("license", "copying", "notice", "patent"))
        if is_acknowledgements:
            relative = file.relative_to(source_root)
            revision = subprocess.run(["git", "log", "-1", "--format=%h", "--", str(relative)], cwd=source_root, capture_output=True, text=True, check=False).stdout.strip() or "unavailable"
            result.extend(acknowledgement_components(file, source_root, revision))
            continue
        if not is_readme and not is_license_doc:
            continue
        body = read_text(file)
        if not body:
            continue
        head = "\n".join(body.splitlines()[:20])
        if is_readme:
            match = re.search(r"(?im)^\s*(?:license|licensing)\s*[:=-]\s*(.+)$", body)
            if not match:
                continue
            body = match.group(0)
            head = body
        license_id = license_id_from_text(head, f"LicenseRef-{file.parent.name}-{file.name}")
        copyright = copyright_lines(body[:12000]) or f"See {file.relative_to(root)}"
        relative = file.relative_to(root)
        component_root = root / relative.parts[0] if len(relative.parts) > 1 else file
        version_path = str(component_root.relative_to(source_root))
        if version_path not in revisions:
            revisions[version_path] = subprocess.run(["git", "log", "-1", "--format=%h", "--", version_path], cwd=source_root, capture_output=True, text=True, check=False).stdout.strip()
        revision = revisions[version_path]
        version = f"vendored revision {revision}" if revision else "vendored source version not recorded"
        result.append({"name": f"Vendored: {file.relative_to(root)}", "version": version, "license": license_id, "copyright": copyright, "text": body})
    return result


def python_components(roots: list[Path]) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
    result = []
    seen = set()
    for root in roots:
        if not root.exists():
            continue
        for metadata in sorted(root.rglob("*.dist-info")):
            if not metadata.is_dir() or metadata in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(metadata)
            name, _, version = metadata.name.removesuffix(".dist-info").rpartition("-")
            licenses = [p for p in metadata.rglob("*") if p.is_file() and ("license" in p.name.lower() or "copying" in p.name.lower() or "notice" in p.name.lower())]
            text = "\n\n".join(read_text(p) for p in licenses if read_text(p))
            license_id = f"LicenseRef-Python-{name}"
            for candidate in (metadata / "METADATA", metadata / "PKG-INFO"):
                content = read_text(candidate)
                match = re.search(r"(?m)^License:\s*(.+)$", content)
                if match:
                    license_id = match.group(1).strip()
                    break
            result.append({"name": f"Python package {name}", "version": version or "unknown", "license": license_id, "copyright": copyright_lines(text) or "See package metadata and license files.", "text": text or "No license file was present in this installed dist-info directory."})
    return result


def ffmpeg_details(args: argparse.Namespace) -> str:
    status = read_text(args.vcpkg_root / "installed" / "vcpkg" / "status") if args.vcpkg_root else ""
    # CMake's installed root can differ from the vcpkg checkout.
    status = status or read_text(args.triplet_dir.parent / "vcpkg" / "status")
    packages = [block for block in re.split(r"\n\s*\n", status) if re.search(r"(?m)^Package: ffmpeg$", block)]
    package = next((block for block in packages if re.search(r"(?m)^Feature:", block) is None), "")
    features = []
    if package:
        features.extend(re.findall(r"(?m)^Default-Features: (.+)$", package))
    features.extend(re.search(r"(?m)^Feature: ([^\n]+)$", block).group(1) for block in packages if re.search(r"(?m)^Feature: ([^\n]+)$", block) and re.search(r"(?m)^Status: install ok installed$", block))
    features = sorted(set(", ".join(features).replace(", ", " ").split()))
    logs = []
    portfile = None
    if args.vcpkg_root:
        buildtrees = args.vcpkg_root / "buildtrees" / "ffmpeg"
        logs = list(buildtrees.glob("*-config.log")) if buildtrees.exists() else []
        candidate = args.vcpkg_root / "ports" / "ffmpeg" / "portfile.cmake"
        portfile = candidate if candidate.exists() else None
    options = []
    for log in logs:
        content = read_text(log)
        command = next((line for line in content.splitlines() if "/configure " in line and line.startswith("# ")), "")
        candidate = re.findall(r"--(?:enable|disable|with|without)-[A-Za-z0-9_+-]+(?:=[^\s'\"]+)?", command)
        aligned = ("x264" in features) == ("--enable-libx264" in candidate)
        aligned &= ("openh264" in features) == ("--enable-libopenh264" in candidate)
        if command and aligned:
            options = candidate
            break
    option_source = "matching vcpkg FFmpeg build configure log" if options else "no configure log matching installed feature status"
    manifest = json.loads(read_text(args.source / "vcpkg.json") or "{}")
    baseline = manifest.get("builtin-baseline", "not recorded")
    spdx = args.triplet_dir / "share" / "ffmpeg" / "vcpkg.spdx.json"
    source_tag = "not recorded"
    if spdx.exists():
        data = json.loads(spdx.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        source = next((p.get("downloadLocation", "") for p in data.get("packages", []) if p.get("name", "").startswith("ffmpeg/")), "")
        source_tag = source or source_tag
    overlays = sorted(p for p in args.source.glob(".github/overlays/*/portfile.cmake") if p.parent.name in {"ffmpeg", "x264"})
    overlay_text = ", ".join(str(p.relative_to(args.source).parent) for p in overlays) or "none found"
    x264_package = next((p for p in installed_ports(args.triplet_dir, args.vcpkg_root) if p["name"] == "x264"), None)
    x264_source = "not installed in this triplet"
    x264_spdx = args.triplet_dir / "share" / "x264" / "vcpkg.spdx.json"
    if x264_spdx.exists():
        x264_data = json.loads(x264_spdx.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        x264_source = next((p.get("downloadLocation", "") for p in x264_data.get("packages", []) if p.get("SPDXID") == "SPDXRef-port"), "") or x264_source
    requested_features = []
    for dependency in manifest.get("dependencies", []):
        if isinstance(dependency, dict) and dependency.get("name") == "ffmpeg":
            requested_features = dependency.get("features", [])
    status_note = ""
    if requested_features and set(requested_features) != set(features):
        status_note = f"; manifest requests {', '.join(requested_features)}, installed status differs"
    gpl = "x264" in features or "gpl" in features
    return "\n".join([
        "### FFmpeg build configuration",
        "",
        f"- Generated from the vcpkg triplet installed at package time: `{args.triplet_dir.name}`.",
        f"- Version: {next((p['version'] for p in installed_ports(args.triplet_dir, args.vcpkg_root) if p['name'] == 'ffmpeg'), 'not installed')}",
        f"- Installed vcpkg features: {', '.join(features) or 'not available in vcpkg status'}",
        f"- Configure options ({option_source}): {', '.join(sorted(set(options))) or 'not found in available vcpkg logs/port recipe'}",
        f"- Resulting build license: {'GPL (x264 feature is installed)' if gpl else 'x264 is not installed in this triplet; do not label this build GPL because of x264'}{status_note}",
        f"- Corresponding FFmpeg source: {source_tag}",
        f"- x264 version/source: {x264_package['version'] if x264_package else 'not installed'}; {x264_source}",
        f"- vcpkg baseline: {baseline}; repository overlay ports: {overlay_text}",
    ])


def validate_coverage(document: str, triplet_dir: Path, install_prefix: Path) -> list[str]:
    errors = []
    for metadata in sorted((triplet_dir / "share").glob("*/vcpkg.spdx.json")):
        data = json.loads(metadata.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        package = next((p for p in data.get("packages", []) if p.get("SPDXID") == "SPDXRef-port"), {})
        name = package.get("name", metadata.parent.name)
        if not re.search(rf"(?m)^\|\s*{re.escape(name)}\s*\|", document):
            errors.append(f"installed vcpkg port missing from notices: {name}")
    shared = {".so", ".dylib", ".dll"}
    for path in install_prefix.rglob("*"):
        if path.is_file() and (path.suffix.lower() in shared or ".so." in path.name):
            if path.name not in document:
                errors.append(f"installed shared library missing from notices: {path.name}")
    nvidia_license = {
        "nvjpeg2k": ("LicenseRef-NVIDIA-nvJPEG2000", "runtime files .so and .h, nvjpeg2k_0.dll"),
        **{
            token: ("LicenseRef-NVIDIA-CUDA-Toolkit", marker)
            for token, (_, marker) in NVIDIA_CUDA_RUNTIME_COMPONENTS.items()
        },
    }
    for path in install_prefix.rglob("*"):
        if not path.is_file() or not re.search(r"(?i)(?:^|lib)(?:cuda|nv)[A-Za-z0-9_]*", path.name):
            continue
        name = path.name.lower()
        source_built = any(part in name for part in ("nvimgcodec", "nvjpeg_ext", "nvjpeg2k_ext"))
        runtime_kind = next((kind for kind in nvidia_license if kind in name), None)
        if source_built:
            if path.name not in document:
                errors.append(f"installed NVIDIA source-built library missing from notices: {path.name}")
        elif runtime_kind:
            license_id, license_marker = nvidia_license[runtime_kind]
            if path.name not in document or license_id not in document or license_marker not in document:
                errors.append(f"installed NVIDIA runtime missing its file and license notice: {path.name}")
        else:
            errors.append(f"NVIDIA runtime file is not listed in the reviewed CUDA Toolkit EULA Attachment A: {path.name}")
    return errors


def generate(args: argparse.Namespace) -> str:
    ports = installed_ports(args.triplet_dir, args.vcpkg_root)
    components = ports + vendored_components(args.source / "external", args.source)
    components += vendored_components(args.source / "resources/licenses", args.source)
    components += python_components([args.install_prefix, args.triplet_dir / "tools" / "python3", args.source])
    # Include bundled font and icon notices that are shipped as application assets.
    assets = [args.source / "src/visualizer/gui/assets/fonts", args.source / "src/visualizer/gui/assets/icon", args.source / "src/rendering/resources/assets"]
    for root in assets:
        if root.exists():
            components += vendored_components(root, args.source)
    sdk_requirements = read_text(args.source / "tools/license_texts/NVIDIA-SDK-Distribution-Requirements.txt")
    nvidia_texts = {
        "LicenseRef-NVIDIA-CUDA-Toolkit": "\n\n".join((sdk_requirements, read_text(args.source / "tools/license_texts/NVIDIA-CUDA-Toolkit-redistribution.txt"))),
        "LicenseRef-NVIDIA-nvJPEG2000": "\n\n".join((sdk_requirements, read_text(args.source / "tools/license_texts/NVIDIA-nvJPEG2000-Supplement.txt"))),
    }
    seen_nvidia_runtimes = set()
    for path in sorted(args.install_prefix.rglob("*")):
        if not path.is_file():
            continue
        lower = path.name.lower()
        if "nvjpeg2k" in lower and "ext" not in lower:
            license_id = "LicenseRef-NVIDIA-nvJPEG2000"
            name = "NVIDIA nvJPEG2000 runtime"
            version_match = re.search(r"(?:so\.|_)(\d+(?:\.\d+)+)", path.resolve().name, re.IGNORECASE)
            version = version_match.group(1) if version_match else "version supplied by NVIDIA runtime filename"
        elif any(token in lower for token in NVIDIA_CUDA_RUNTIME_COMPONENTS) and not any(
            token in lower for token in ("nvimgcodec", "_ext")
        ):
            license_id = "LicenseRef-NVIDIA-CUDA-Toolkit"
            token = next(token for token in NVIDIA_CUDA_RUNTIME_COMPONENTS if token in lower)
            name = NVIDIA_CUDA_RUNTIME_COMPONENTS[token][0]
            version_match = re.search(r"(?:so\.|dll[._]?|_)(\d+(?:\.\d+)+)", path.resolve().name, re.IGNORECASE)
            version = version_match.group(1) if version_match else "version supplied by NVIDIA runtime filename"
        else:
            continue
        runtime_key = (license_id, name, path.resolve())
        if runtime_key in seen_nvidia_runtimes:
            continue
        seen_nvidia_runtimes.add(runtime_key)
        components.append({"name": name, "version": version, "license": license_id, "copyright": "Copyright NVIDIA Corporation. All rights reserved.", "text": nvidia_texts[license_id]})
    groups: dict[str, list[dict[str, str]]] = defaultdict(list)
    for component in components:
        groups[component["license"]].append(component)

    lines = ["# Third-party licenses", "", "Generated at install time from the selected vcpkg triplet and files shipped with this distribution.", "",
             "LichtFeld Studio is licensed under GPL-3.0-or-later (LICENSE) with an additional permission for NVIDIA GPU libraries (LICENSE-EXCEPTION.txt).", "",
             f"Library count: **{len(components)}**", ""]
    for license_id in sorted(groups, key=str.casefold):
        rows = sorted(groups[license_id], key=lambda x: (x["name"].casefold(), x["version"]))
        lines += [f"## {license_id}", "", "| Library | Version | Copyright |", "|---|---|---|"]
        for row in rows:
            safe = lambda value: value.replace("|", "\\|").replace("\n", " ")
            lines.append(f"| {safe(row['name'])} | {safe(row['version'])} | {safe(row['copyright'])} |")
        # One representative full text for this license group, keeping distinct
        # texts for license expressions that combine multiple SPDX identifiers.
        texts = sorted({row["text"] for row in rows if row["text"]})
        if texts:
            lines += ["", "### License text", "", "```text", max(texts, key=len), "```"]
        lines.append("")
    shared_names = sorted({p.name for p in args.install_prefix.rglob("*") if p.is_file() and (p.suffix.lower() in {".so", ".dylib", ".dll"} or ".so." in p.name)})
    nvidia_paths = [
        path for path in sorted(args.install_prefix.rglob("*"))
        if path.is_file() and re.search(r"(?i)(?:^|lib)(?:cuda|nv)[A-Za-z0-9_]*", path.name)
    ]
    cuda_runtime_present = any(
        any(token in path.name.lower() for token in NVIDIA_CUDA_RUNTIME_COMPONENTS)
        and not any(token in path.name.lower() for token in ("nvimgcodec", "_ext"))
        and "nvjpeg2k" not in path.name.lower()
        for path in nvidia_paths
    )
    nvjpeg2k_present = any(
        "nvjpeg2k" in path.name.lower() and "ext" not in path.name.lower()
        for path in nvidia_paths
    )
    notice = [
        "This distribution includes NVIDIA components. Copyright NVIDIA Corporation. All rights reserved.",
        "The NVIDIA files found in the installed payload are listed below. Runtime redistribution is subject to the applicable NVIDIA agreement and its stated requirements.",
    ]
    if cuda_runtime_present:
        notice.append("The CUDA Toolkit agreement requirements and relevant Attachment A entries are reproduced under `LicenseRef-NVIDIA-CUDA-Toolkit`.")
    if nvjpeg2k_present:
        notice.append("The applicable nvJPEG2000 Supplement and NVIDIA SDK distribution requirements are reproduced under `LicenseRef-NVIDIA-nvJPEG2000`.")
    notice.append("nvImageCodec and its extensions are built from vendored source and carry their own source notices.")
    lines += ["## Installed shared libraries", "", *[f"- `{name}`" for name in shared_names], "", ffmpeg_details(args), "", "### NVIDIA notices", "", *notice, "", "References: https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/eula/index.html and https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvjpeg2000/license.html", ""]
    for path in nvidia_paths:
        name = path.name
        lower = name.lower()
        if any(part in lower for part in ("nvimgcodec", "nvjpeg_ext", "nvjpeg2k_ext")):
            classification = "vendored nvImageCodec source build; see its bundled source license"
        elif "nvjpeg2k" in lower:
            classification = "nvJPEG2000 runtime; see LicenseRef-NVIDIA-nvJPEG2000 and its Supplement"
        elif any(token in lower for token in NVIDIA_CUDA_RUNTIME_COMPONENTS):
            classification = "NVIDIA runtime; see LicenseRef-NVIDIA-CUDA-Toolkit and Attachment A"
        else:
            classification = "not listed in CUDA Toolkit EULA Attachment A; package check fails"
        lines.append(f"- `{name}`: {classification}")
    return "\n".join(lines).rstrip() + "\n"


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--source", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--triplet-dir", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--install-prefix", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--vcpkg-root", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--check", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    document = generate(args)
    args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    args.output.write_text(document, encoding="utf-8")
    errors = validate_coverage(document, args.triplet_dir, args.install_prefix) if args.check else []
    if errors:
        print("\n".join(errors), file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    print(f"Generated {args.output} ({len(installed_ports(args.triplet_dir, args.vcpkg_root))} vcpkg ports)")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
