    Tensor Camera::K() const {
        // Create [1, 3, 3] zero matrix on same device as world_view_transform
        auto K = Tensor::zeros({1, 3, 3}, _world_view_transform.device());
        auto [fx, fy, cx, cy] = get_intrinsics();

        // Fill in the intrinsic matrix on CPU then move to device
        auto K_cpu = K.cpu();
        auto K_acc = K_cpu.accessor<float, 3>();
        K_acc(0, 0, 0) = fx;
        K_acc(0, 1, 1) = fy;
        K_acc(0, 0, 2) = cx;
        K_acc(0, 1, 2) = cy;
        K_acc(0, 2, 2) = 1.0f;

        return K_cpu.to(_world_view_transform.device()).contiguous();
    }

    std::tuple<float, float, float, float> Camera::get_intrinsics() const {
        const float x_scale = static_cast<float>(_image_width) / static_cast<float>(_camera_width);
        const float y_scale = static_cast<float>(_image_height) / static_cast<float>(_camera_height);
        return {_focal_x * x_scale, _focal_y * y_scale, _center_x * x_scale, _center_y * y_scale};
    }

    Tensor Camera::load_and_get_image(int resize_factor, int max_width, const bool output_uint8,
                                      const bool update_dimensions) {
        return load_and_get_image(resize_factor, max_width, output_uint8, update_dimensions,
                                  load_image_cached);
    }

    Tensor Camera::load_and_get_image(int resize_factor, int max_width, const bool output_uint8,
                                      const bool update_dimensions,
                                      const ImageLoadFunc& image_loader) {
        if (!_has_image) {
            throw std::runtime_error(std::format(
                "Dataset image '{}' is missing: {}",
                _image_name,
                lfs::core::path_to_utf8(_image_path)));
        }

        const ImageLoadParams params{
            .path = _image_path,
            .resize_factor = resize_factor,
            .max_width = max_width,
            .stream = _stream,
            .output_uint8 = output_uint8};

        auto image = image_loader(params);
        if (update_dimensions) {
            const auto shape = image.shape();
            _image_width = shape[2];
            _image_height = shape[1];
            _image_size_loaded = true;
        }

        if (image.device() != Device::CUDA) {
            image = image.to(Device::CUDA, _stream);
            if (_stream) {
                LFS_CUDA_TRY(cudaStreamSynchronize(_stream), _stream, "image upload sync");
            }
        }

        return image;
    }

    void Camera::load_image_size(int resize_factor, int max_width) {
        if (_undistort_prepared) {
            const auto grid = compute_undistort_grid(_undistort_params, resize_factor, max_width);
            _image_width = grid.width;
            _image_height = grid.height;
            _image_size_loaded = true;
            return;
        }

        int w, h;
        if (!_has_image) {
            w = _camera_width;
            h = _camera_height;
        } else {
            auto result = get_image_info(_image_path);
            w = std::get<0>(result);
            h = std::get<1>(result);
        }
        _source_image_width = w;
        _source_image_height = h;

        LOG_DEBUG("load_image_size(): Base dimensions: {}x{}, resize_factor={}, max_width={}",
                  w, h, resize_factor, max_width);

        if (resize_factor > 0) {
            if (w % resize_factor || h % resize_factor) {
                LOG_WARN("width or height are not divisible by resize_factor w {} h {} resize_factor {}", w, h, resize_factor);
            }
            _image_width = w / resize_factor;
            _image_height = h / resize_factor;
        } else {
            _image_width = w;
            _image_height = h;
        }

        LOG_DEBUG("load_image_size(): After resize_factor: {}x{}", _image_width, _image_height);

        if (max_width > 0 && (_image_width > max_width || _image_height > max_width)) {
            int old_width = _image_width;
            int old_height = _image_height;

            if (_image_width > _image_height) {
                _image_width = max_width;
                _image_height = (old_height * max_width) / old_width; // Fixed: Use old_width
                LOG_DEBUG("load_image_size(): Resized {}x{} → {}x{} (limited by max_width={})",
                          old_width, old_height, _image_width, _image_height, max_width);
            } else {
                _image_height = max_width;
                _image_width = (old_width * max_width) / old_height; // Fixed: Use old_height
                LOG_DEBUG("load_image_size(): Resized {}x{} → {}x{} (limited by max_width={})",
                          old_width, old_height, _image_width, _image_height, max_width);
            }
        }

        LOG_DEBUG("load_image_size(): Final dimensions: {}x{}", _image_width, _image_height);
        _image_size_loaded = true;
    }

    size_t Camera::get_num_bytes_from_file(int resize_factor, int max_width) const {
        if (!_has_image) {
            return 0;
        }
        auto result = get_image_info(_image_path);

        int w = std::get<0>(result);
        int h = std::get<1>(result);
        int c = std::get<2>(result);

        if (_undistort_prepared) {
            const auto grid = compute_undistort_grid(_undistort_params, resize_factor, max_width);
            return static_cast<size_t>(grid.width) * grid.height * c * sizeof(uint8_t);
        }

        if (resize_factor > 0) {
            w = w / resize_factor;
            h = h / resize_factor;
        }

        if (max_width > 0 && (w > max_width || h > max_width)) {
            if (w > h) {
                h = (h * max_width) / w;
                w = max_width;
            } else {
                w = (w * max_width) / h;
                h = max_width;
            }
        }

        size_t num_bytes = w * h * c * sizeof(uint8_t);
        return num_bytes;
    }

    size_t Camera::get_num_bytes_from_file() const {
        if (!_has_image) {
            return 0;
        }
        auto [w, h, c] = get_image_info(_image_path);
        size_t num_bytes = w * h * c * sizeof(uint8_t);
        return num_bytes;
    }

    static bool path_is_under_root(const std::filesystem::path& stored,
                                   const std::filesystem::path& old_root,
                                   std::filesystem::path& relative_out) {
        const auto relative =
            stored.lexically_normal().lexically_relative(old_root.lexically_normal());
        if (relative.empty()) {
            return false;
        }
        const auto first = relative.begin();
        if (first != relative.end() && *first == "..") {
            return false;
        }
        relative_out = relative;
        return true;
    }

    static void rebase_path_if_under(std::filesystem::path& stored,
                                     const std::filesystem::path& old_root,
                                     const std::filesystem::path& new_root) {
        if (stored.empty()) {
            return;
        }
        std::filesystem::path relative;
        if (!path_is_under_root(stored, old_root, relative)) {
            return;
        }
        stored = new_root / relative;
    }

    void Camera::rebase_asset_paths(const std::filesystem::path& old_root,
                                    const std::filesystem::path& new_root) {
        rebase_path_if_under(_image_path, old_root, new_root);
        rebase_path_if_under(_mask_path, old_root, new_root);
        rebase_path_if_under(_depth_path, old_root, new_root);
        rebase_path_if_under(_normal_path, old_root, new_root);
    }

    void Camera::set_depth_path(std::filesystem::path path) {
        _depth_path = std::move(path);
        _depth_quantization_step = -1.0f;
        release_depth_cache();
    }

    void Camera::set_normal_path(std::filesystem::path path) {
        _normal_path = std::move(path);
        release_normal_cache();
    }

    void Camera::set_mask_path(std::filesystem::path path) {
        _mask_path = std::move(path);
        _cached_mask = Tensor();
        _mask_loaded = false;
    }

    void Camera::set_mask_tensor(Tensor mask) {
        _in_memory_mask_raw = std::move(mask);
        ++_mask_revision;
        // Force reprocessing on the next load_and_get_mask call.
        _cached_mask = Tensor();
        _mask_loaded = false;
    }

    Tensor Camera::read_mask_image(const std::filesystem::path& path, const int resize_factor, const int max_width,
                                   const bool apply_undistortion) const {
        Tensor mask;
        const bool warp_full_resolution = _undistort_prepared && apply_undistortion;
        const ImageLoadParams params{
            .path = path,
            .resize_factor = warp_full_resolution ? 1 : resize_factor,
            .max_width = warp_full_resolution ? 0 : max_width,
            .stream = _stream,
            .mask_grayscale = true};

        mask = load_image_cached(params);

        if (mask.device() != Device::CUDA) {
            mask = mask.to(Device::CUDA, _stream);
            if (_stream) {
                LFS_CUDA_TRY(cudaStreamSynchronize(_stream), _stream, "mask upload sync");
            }
        }

        // Convert RGB [C,H,W] to grayscale [H,W]
        if (mask.ndim() == 3 && mask.shape()[0] >= 3) {
            const auto r = mask.slice(0, 0, 1).squeeze(0);
            const auto g = mask.slice(0, 1, 2).squeeze(0);
            const auto b = mask.slice(0, 2, 3).squeeze(0);
            mask = (r + g + b) / 3.0f;
        } else if (mask.ndim() == 3 && mask.shape()[0] == 1) {
            mask = mask.squeeze(0);
        }
        if (warp_full_resolution) {
            const auto scaled = prepare_undistort_params(
                _undistort_params, static_cast<int>(mask.shape()[1]), static_cast<int>(mask.shape()[0]),
                resize_factor, max_width);
            mask = undistort_mask_area(mask, scaled, _stream);
        }
        // Match the sidecar training cache before inversion and classification.
        cuda::quantize_mask_to_byte_grid(mask, false);
        return mask;
    }

    Tensor Camera::finish_mask(Tensor mask, const int resize_factor, const int max_width, const bool invert_mask,
                               const float mask_threshold, const bool binarize, const bool apply_undistortion) const {
        if (invert_mask) {
            mask = Tensor::full(mask.shape(), 1.0f, mask.device()) - mask;
        }

        if (_undistort_prepared && apply_undistortion) {
            const auto scaled = prepare_undistort_params(
                _undistort_params,
                static_cast<int>(mask.shape()[1]),
                static_cast<int>(mask.shape()[0]),
                resize_factor,
                max_width);
            mask = undistort_mask_area(mask, scaled, _stream);
        }

        if (binarize) {
            const float final_threshold = mask_threshold > 0.0f && mask_threshold <= 1.0f
                                              ? mask_threshold
                                              : 0.5f;
            mask = cuda::threshold_mask(mask, final_threshold);
        } else {
            // Keep Float32 [0,1] so undistorted samples match the pipelined
            // loader / fused-kernel domain (kMaskKeepMin). Rounding through
            // UInt8 truncates interpolated values such as 250.6 → 250.
            mask = mask.contiguous();
        }
        if (_stream) {
            LFS_CUDA_TRY(cudaStreamSynchronize(_stream), _stream, "mask load sync");
        }
        return mask;
    }

    Tensor Camera::load_mask_file(const std::filesystem::path& path, const int resize_factor, const int max_width,
                                  const bool invert_mask, const float mask_threshold, const bool binarize,
                                  const bool apply_undistortion) const {
        const CUDAStreamGuard stream_guard(_stream);
        return finish_mask(read_mask_image(path, resize_factor, max_width, apply_undistortion), resize_factor,
                           max_width, invert_mask, mask_threshold, binarize, false);
    }

    Tensor Camera::load_and_get_mask(const int resize_factor, const int max_width,
                                     const bool invert_mask, const float mask_threshold,
                                     const bool binarize, const bool apply_undistortion) {
        if (_mask_loaded && _cached_mask.is_valid() &&
            _cached_mask_resize_factor == resize_factor &&
            _cached_mask_max_width == max_width &&
            _cached_mask_invert == invert_mask &&
            _cached_mask_threshold == mask_threshold &&
            _cached_mask_binarize == binarize &&
            _cached_mask_was_undistorted == (_undistort_prepared && apply_undistortion)) {
            return _cached_mask;
        }
        // Loading stays on this camera's stream so uploads, intermediates and their reuse are ordered.
        const CUDAStreamGuard stream_guard(_stream);

        Tensor mask;
        if (_in_memory_mask_raw.is_valid()) {
            // A source-grid mask follows the selected image file's resize.
            // Already-resized and unknown-grid masks keep their accepted shape.
            mask = _in_memory_mask_raw;
            if (mask.device() != Device::CUDA) {
                mask = mask.to(Device::CUDA, _stream);
                if (_stream) {
                    LFS_CUDA_TRY(cudaStreamSynchronize(_stream), _stream, "mask upload sync");
                }
            }
            if (mask.dtype() == DataType::UInt8) {
                mask = cuda::normalize_mask_bytes(mask);
            } else if (mask.dtype() != DataType::Float32) {
                mask = mask.to(DataType::Float32);
            }
            // Allow (1, H, W) or (H, W, 1) shapes by squeezing the singleton.
            if (mask.ndim() == 3 && mask.shape()[0] == 1) {
                mask = mask.squeeze(0);
            } else if (mask.ndim() == 3 && mask.shape()[2] == 1) {
                mask = mask.squeeze(2);
            }
            if (mask.ndim() == 2 && !(_undistort_prepared && apply_undistortion) &&
                (resize_factor > 1 || max_width > 0)) {
                if (_source_image_width <= 0 || _source_image_height <= 0) {
                    if (_has_image && !_image_path.empty()) {
                        std::error_code error;
                        if (lfs::core::native_fs::exists(_image_path, error) && !error) {
                            try {
                                const auto [width, height, channels] = get_image_info(_image_path);
                                if (width > 0 && height > 0) {
                                    _source_image_width = width;
                                    _source_image_height = height;
                                }
                            } catch (const std::exception& error) {
                                LOG_DEBUG("Keeping injected mask after image size probe failed: {}", error.what());
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    if (_source_image_width <= 0 || _source_image_height <= 0) {
                        _source_image_width = _camera_width;
                        _source_image_height = _camera_height;
                    }
                }
                if (_source_image_width > 0 && _source_image_height > 0 &&
                    mask.shape()[0] == static_cast<size_t>(_source_image_height) &&
                    mask.shape()[1] == static_cast<size_t>(_source_image_width)) {
                    const auto [target_width, target_height] = resized_image_dimensions(
                        _source_image_width, _source_image_height, resize_factor, max_width);
                    if (target_width != _source_image_width || target_height != _source_image_height)
                        mask = lanczos_resize_grayscale(mask, target_height, target_width, 2, _stream);
                }
            }
        } else if (!_mask_path.empty() && lfs::core::native_fs::exists(_mask_path)) {
            mask = read_mask_image(_mask_path, resize_factor, max_width, apply_undistortion);
        } else {
            return Tensor();
        }

        mask = finish_mask(std::move(mask), resize_factor, max_width, invert_mask, mask_threshold, binarize,
                           apply_undistortion && _in_memory_mask_raw.is_valid());
        _cached_mask = mask;
        _mask_loaded = true;
        _cached_mask_resize_factor = resize_factor;
        _cached_mask_max_width = max_width;
        _cached_mask_invert = invert_mask;
        _cached_mask_threshold = mask_threshold;
        _cached_mask_binarize = binarize;
        _cached_mask_was_undistorted = _undistort_prepared && apply_undistortion;

        LOG_DEBUG("Loaded mask for {}: [{},{}]", _image_name, mask.shape()[0], mask.shape()[1]);

        return _cached_mask;
    }

    Tensor Camera::load_and_get_depth(const int resize_factor, const int max_width) {
        if (_depth_loaded && _cached_depth.is_valid()) {
            return _cached_depth;
        }
        // Loading stays on this camera's stream so uploads, intermediates and their reuse are ordered.
        const CUDAStreamGuard stream_guard(_stream);

        if (_depth_path.empty() || !lfs::core::native_fs::exists(_depth_path)) {
            return Tensor();
        }

        Tensor depth;
        if (auto [gray, native_w, native_h] = load_image_gray_high_bitdepth(_depth_path); gray) {
            auto cpu_depth = Tensor::from_blob(
                gray,
                TensorShape({static_cast<size_t>(native_h), static_cast<size_t>(native_w)}),
                Device::CPU, DataType::Float32);
            depth = cpu_depth.to(Device::CUDA, _stream);
            if (_stream) {
                LFS_CUDA_TRY(cudaStreamSynchronize(_stream), _stream, "depth upload sync");
            }
            free_image_float(gray);
        } else {
            const ImageLoadParams params{
                .path = _depth_path,
                .stream = _stream};

            depth = load_image_cached(params);

            if (depth.device() != Device::CUDA) {
                depth = depth.to(Device::CUDA, _stream);
                if (_stream) {
                    LFS_CUDA_TRY(cudaStreamSynchronize(_stream), _stream, "depth upload sync");
                }
            }

            if (depth.dtype() == DataType::UInt8) {
                depth = depth.to(DataType::Float32).div(255.0f);
            } else if (depth.dtype() != DataType::Float32) {
                depth = depth.to(DataType::Float32);
            }
        }

        // Convert RGB [C,H,W] to grayscale [H,W].
        if (depth.ndim() == 3 && depth.shape()[0] >= 3) {
            const auto r = depth.slice(0, 0, 1).squeeze(0);
            const auto g = depth.slice(0, 1, 2).squeeze(0);
            const auto b = depth.slice(0, 2, 3).squeeze(0);
            depth = (r + g + b) / 3.0f;
        } else if (depth.ndim() == 3 && depth.shape()[0] == 1) {
            depth = depth.squeeze(0);
        } else if (depth.ndim() == 3 && depth.shape()[2] == 1) {
            depth = depth.squeeze(2);
        }

        if (_undistort_prepared) {
            const auto scaled = prepare_undistort_params(
                _undistort_params,
                static_cast<int>(depth.shape()[1]),
                static_cast<int>(depth.shape()[0]),
                resize_factor,
                max_width);
            depth = undistort_depth_area(depth.contiguous(), scaled, _stream);
        } else {
            if (!_image_size_loaded)
                load_image_size(resize_factor, max_width);
            depth = resize_depth_prior(depth.contiguous(), _image_height, _image_width, _stream);
        }

        _cached_depth = depth.contiguous();
        if (_stream) {
            LFS_CUDA_TRY(cudaStreamSynchronize(_stream), _stream, "depth load sync");
        }
        _depth_loaded = true;

        LOG_DEBUG("Loaded depth for {}: [{},{}]", _image_name, _cached_depth.shape()[0], _cached_depth.shape()[1]);

        return _cached_depth;
    }

    Tensor Camera::load_and_get_normal(const int resize_factor, const int max_width,
                                       const NormalPriorDecode& decode,
                                       const bool apply_undistortion) {
        if (_normal_loaded && _cached_normal.is_valid()) {
            return _cached_normal;
        }
        // Loading stays on this camera's stream so uploads, intermediates and their reuse are ordered.
        const CUDAStreamGuard stream_guard(_stream);

        if (_normal_path.empty() || !lfs::core::native_fs::exists(_normal_path)) {
            return Tensor();
        }

        Tensor normal;
        if (auto [rgb, native_w, native_h] = load_image_rgb_high_bitdepth(_normal_path); rgb) {
            auto cpu_normal = Tensor::from_blob(
                rgb,
                TensorShape({static_cast<size_t>(native_h), static_cast<size_t>(native_w), 3}),
                Device::CPU, DataType::Float32);
            normal = cpu_normal.to(Device::CUDA, _stream);
            if (_stream) {
                LFS_CUDA_TRY(cudaStreamSynchronize(_stream), _stream, "normal upload sync");
            }
            free_image_float(rgb);
            normal = normal.permute({2, 0, 1}).contiguous();
        } else {
            const ImageLoadParams params{
                .path = _normal_path,
                .stream = _stream};

            normal = load_image_cached(params);

            if (normal.is_valid() && normal.device() != Device::CUDA) {
                normal = normal.to(Device::CUDA, _stream);
                if (_stream) {
                    LFS_CUDA_TRY(cudaStreamSynchronize(_stream), _stream, "normal upload sync");
                }
            }
            if (normal.is_valid()) {
                if (normal.dtype() == DataType::UInt8) {
                    normal = normal.to(DataType::Float32).div(255.0f);
                } else if (normal.dtype() != DataType::Float32) {
                    normal = normal.to(DataType::Float32);
                }
            }
        }

        if (!normal.is_valid() || normal.ndim() != 3) {
            LOG_WARN("Normal map for {} could not be loaded from {}", _image_name,
                     lfs::core::path_to_utf8(_normal_path));
            return Tensor();
        }
        if (normal.shape()[0] != 3) {
            if (normal.shape()[0] > 3) {
                normal = normal.slice(0, 0, 3).contiguous();
            } else if (normal.shape()[2] == 3) {
                normal = normal.permute({2, 0, 1}).contiguous();
            } else {
                LOG_WARN("Normal map for {} has {} channels, expected 3", _image_name, normal.shape()[0]);
                return Tensor();
            }
        }

        // Decode vectors before validity-aware resampling and normalization.
        normal = normal.mul(2.0f).sub(1.0f);

        if (decode.srgb || decode.flip_yz || decode.world_space) {
            auto normal_cpu = normal.cpu().contiguous();
            const size_t pixel_count = normal_cpu.shape()[1] * normal_cpu.shape()[2];
            if (decode.srgb) {
                srgb_normal_prior_to_linear_chw(normal_cpu.ptr<float>(), pixel_count * 3);
            }
            if (decode.flip_yz) {
                flip_normal_prior_yz_chw(normal_cpu.ptr<float>(), pixel_count);
            }
            if (decode.world_space) {
                const std::array<float, 9> r_w2c = camera_rotation_to_cpu_array(_R);
                std::array<float, 9> world_to_camera{};
                for (size_t row = 0; row < 3; ++row) {
                    for (size_t col = 0; col < 3; ++col) {
                        float sum = 0.0f;
                        for (size_t k = 0; k < 3; ++k) {
                            sum += r_w2c[row * 3 + k] * decode.world_rotation[k * 3 + col];
                        }
                        world_to_camera[row * 3 + col] = sum;
                    }
                }
                transform_normal_prior_world_to_camera_chw(
                    normal_cpu.ptr<float>(),
                    pixel_count,
                    world_to_camera);
            }
            normal = normal_cpu.to(Device::CUDA, _stream);
            if (_stream) {
                LFS_CUDA_TRY(cudaStreamSynchronize(_stream), _stream, "normal upload sync");
            }
        }

        if (_undistort_prepared && apply_undistortion) {
            const auto scaled = prepare_undistort_params(
                _undistort_params,
                static_cast<int>(normal.shape()[2]),
                static_cast<int>(normal.shape()[1]),
                resize_factor,
                max_width);
            normal = undistort_normal_area(normal.contiguous(), scaled, _stream);
        } else {
            if (!_image_size_loaded)
                load_image_size(resize_factor, max_width);
            normal = resize_normal_prior(normal.contiguous(), _image_height, _image_width, _stream);
        }

        _cached_normal = normal.contiguous();
        if (_stream) {
            LFS_CUDA_TRY(cudaStreamSynchronize(_stream), _stream, "normal load sync");
        }
        _normal_loaded = true;

        LOG_DEBUG("Loaded normal map for {}: [{},{}]", _image_name,
                  _cached_normal.shape()[1], _cached_normal.shape()[2]);

        return _cached_normal;
    }

    float Camera::depth_prior_quantization_step() {
        if (_depth_quantization_step < 0.0f) {
            _depth_quantization_step = has_depth() ? image_quantization_step(_depth_path) : 0.0f;
        }
        return _depth_quantization_step;
    }

    void Camera::precompute_undistortion(float blank_pixels) {
        if (_undistort_precomputed)
            return;
        if (!has_distortion())
            return;

        _undistort_params = compute_undistort_params(
            _focal_x, _focal_y, _center_x, _center_y,
            _camera_width, _camera_height,
            _radial_distortion, _tangential_distortion,
            _camera_model_type, blank_pixels);

        _undistort_precomputed = true;
    }

    void Camera::adopt_undistortion(const UndistortParams& params, const UndistortDestination destination) noexcept {
        _undistort_params = params;
        _undistort_destination = destination;
        _undistort_precomputed = true;
    }

    void Camera::prepare_undistortion(float blank_pixels) {
        if (_undistort_prepared)
            return;

        precompute_undistortion(blank_pixels);
        if (!_undistort_precomputed)
            return;

        // The calibration can describe a larger image than the selected image folder.
        // Keep the source calibration intact, but size the shared destination grid
        // at the file's resolution before applying the training resize and cap.
        if (_undistort_destination == UndistortDestination::Calibration &&
            _has_image && lfs::core::native_fs::exists(_image_path)) {
            const auto [width, height, channels] = get_image_info(_image_path);
            auto& params = _undistort_params;
            if (width < params.src_width || height < params.src_height) {
                const int dst_width = std::max(1, static_cast<int>(std::lround(
                                                      static_cast<double>(params.dst_width) *
                                                      std::min(width, params.src_width) / params.src_width)));
                const int dst_height = std::max(1, static_cast<int>(std::lround(
                                                       static_cast<double>(params.dst_height) *
                                                       std::min(height, params.src_height) / params.src_height)));
                const float scale_x = static_cast<float>(dst_width) / params.dst_width;
                const float scale_y = static_cast<float>(dst_height) / params.dst_height;
                params.dst_fx *= scale_x;
                params.dst_fy *= scale_y;
                params.dst_cx *= scale_x;
                params.dst_cy *= scale_y;
                params.dst_width = dst_width;
                params.dst_height = dst_height;
            }
        }

        _focal_x = _undistort_params.dst_fx;
        _focal_y = _undistort_params.dst_fy;
        _center_x = _undistort_params.dst_cx;
        _center_y = _undistort_params.dst_cy;
        _camera_width = _undistort_params.dst_width;
        _camera_height = _undistort_params.dst_height;
        _FoVx = focal2fov(_focal_x, _camera_width);
        _FoVy = focal2fov(_focal_y, _camera_height);
        _undistort_prepared = true;
    }

    void Camera::translate(const Tensor& trans) {
        // Shift the camera's world-space position by trans.
        // For the view transform: new T = T - R * trans
        // (so that p_cam = R*p_world_new + T_new still holds after shifting world by trans)
        auto R_cpu = _R.cpu().contiguous();
        auto T_cpu = _T.cpu().contiguous();
        auto t_cpu = trans.cpu().contiguous();

        auto R_acc = R_cpu.accessor<float, 2>();
        auto T_acc = T_cpu.accessor<float, 1>();
        auto t_acc = t_cpu.accessor<float, 1>();

        std::vector<float> T_new(3);
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
            float Rt_i = 0.f;
            for (int j = 0; j < 3; ++j)
                Rt_i += R_acc(i, j) * t_acc(j);
            T_new[i] = T_acc(i) - Rt_i;
        }

        _T = Tensor::from_vector(T_new, {3}, Device::CPU);
        _world_view_transform = world_to_view(_R, _T);
        _cam_position = _cam_position + trans.to(Device::CUDA).contiguous();
        if (_sfm_observation_source)
            set_sfm_observations(sfm_observations());
        for (auto& observation : _sfm_observations) {
            observation.x += t_acc(0);
            observation.y += t_acc(1);
            observation.z += t_acc(2);
        }
    }

    bool Camera::has_distortion() const noexcept {
        // Equirectangular is a complete projection model handled natively by the
        // rasterizer; there is no pinhole image to "undistort" to, so it must not
        // be routed through the undistortion path.
        if (_camera_model_type == CameraModelType::EQUIRECTANGULAR)
            return false;
        if (_radial_distortion.is_valid() && _radial_distortion.numel() > 0)
            return true;
        if (_tangential_distortion.is_valid() && _tangential_distortion.numel() > 0)
            return true;
        if (_camera_model_type != CameraModelType::PINHOLE)
            return true;
        return false;
    }

} // namespace lfs::core

/* SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2025 LichtFeld Studio Authors
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later */

#include "core/checkpoint_format.hpp"
#include "core/logger.hpp"
#include "core/native_fs.hpp"
#include "core/path_utils.hpp"
#include <fstream>
#include <nlohmann/json.hpp>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <utility>

namespace lfs::core {

    namespace {

        std::expected<CheckpointHeader, std::string> open_and_validate(
            const std::filesystem::path& path, std::ifstream& file) {

            if (!open_file_for_read(path, std::ios::binary, file)) {
                return std::unexpected("Failed to open: " + path_to_utf8(path));
            }

            std::error_code size_error;
            const auto file_size = native_fs::file_size(path, size_error);
            if (size_error) {
                return std::unexpected("Failed to inspect checkpoint size: " + size_error.message());
            }

            CheckpointHeader header{};
            file.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(&header), sizeof(header));
            if (!file)
                return std::unexpected("Invalid checkpoint: truncated header");
            if (auto validation = validate_checkpoint_header(header, file_size); !validation)
                return std::unexpected(validation.error());
            return header;
        }

        std::expected<void, std::string> skip_strategy_name(
            std::istream& file,
            const CheckpointHeader& header) {
            uint32_t type_len = 0;
            file.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(&type_len), sizeof(type_len));
            if (!file)
                return std::unexpected("Invalid checkpoint: truncated strategy name length");
            if (type_len == 0 || type_len > MAX_CHECKPOINT_STRATEGY_NAME_BYTES)
                return std::unexpected("Invalid checkpoint: strategy name length is out of bounds");

            const auto name_offset = file.tellg();
            if (name_offset == std::streampos(-1))
                return std::unexpected("Invalid checkpoint: cannot locate strategy name");
            if (header.params_json_size > 0 &&
                (static_cast<uint64_t>(name_offset) > header.params_json_offset ||
                 type_len > header.params_json_offset - static_cast<uint64_t>(name_offset))) {
                return std::unexpected("Invalid checkpoint: strategy name overlaps parameter JSON");
            }
            file.seekg(static_cast<std::streamoff>(type_len), std::ios::cur);
            if (!file)
                return std::unexpected("Invalid checkpoint: truncated strategy name");
            return {};
        }

        CheckpointHeaderLoadResult read_and_validate(
            std::istream& file,
            const uint64_t file_size) {
            CheckpointHeader header{};
            file.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(&header), sizeof(header));
            if (!file)
                return std::unexpected("Invalid checkpoint: truncated header");
            if (auto validation = validate_checkpoint_header(header, file_size);
                !validation) {
                return std::unexpected(validation.error());
            }
            return header;
        }

    } // namespace

    std::expected<void, std::string> validate_checkpoint_header(
        const CheckpointHeader& header,
        const uint64_t file_size) {
        if (file_size < sizeof(CheckpointHeader))
            return std::unexpected("Invalid checkpoint: truncated header");
        if (file_size > MAX_CHECKPOINT_FILE_BYTES)
            return std::unexpected("Invalid checkpoint: file exceeds byte budget");
        if (header.magic != CHECKPOINT_MAGIC)
            return std::unexpected("Invalid checkpoint: wrong magic");
        if (header.version < CHECKPOINT_MIN_SUPPORTED_VERSION ||
            header.version > CHECKPOINT_VERSION)
            return std::unexpected("Unsupported version: " + std::to_string(header.version));
        if (header.iteration < 0)
            return std::unexpected("Invalid checkpoint: iteration must be nonnegative");
        if (header.num_gaussians > MAX_CHECKPOINT_GAUSSIANS)
            return std::unexpected("Invalid checkpoint: Gaussian count exceeds budget");
        if (header.sh_degree < 0 || header.sh_degree > 3)
            return std::unexpected("Invalid checkpoint: unsupported SH degree");

        auto known_flags = static_cast<uint32_t>(CheckpointFlags::HAS_BILATERAL_GRID) |
                           static_cast<uint32_t>(CheckpointFlags::HAS_PPISP) |
                           static_cast<uint32_t>(CheckpointFlags::HAS_PPISP_CONTROLLER);
        if (header.version >= CHECKPOINT_VERSION_HAS_SPARSITY) {
            known_flags |= static_cast<uint32_t>(CheckpointFlags::HAS_SPARSITY);
        }
        if (header.version >= CHECKPOINT_VERSION_HAS_POPSPA)
            known_flags |= static_cast<uint32_t>(CheckpointFlags::HAS_POPSPA);
        if ((static_cast<uint32_t>(header.flags) & ~known_flags) != 0)
            return std::unexpected("Invalid checkpoint: unknown feature flags");
        if (has_flag(header.flags, CheckpointFlags::HAS_SPARSITY) && has_flag(header.flags, CheckpointFlags::HAS_POPSPA))
            return std::unexpected("Invalid checkpoint: mutually exclusive sparsity features");

        if (header.params_json_size > MAX_CHECKPOINT_JSON_BYTES)
            return std::unexpected("Invalid checkpoint: parameter JSON exceeds byte budget");
        if (header.params_json_size > 0) {
            if (header.params_json_offset < sizeof(CheckpointHeader) ||
                header.params_json_offset > file_size ||
                header.params_json_size > file_size - header.params_json_offset) {
                return std::unexpected("Invalid checkpoint: parameter JSON range is outside the file");
            }
        }
        return {};
    }

    std::expected<CheckpointHeader, std::string> load_checkpoint_header(
        const std::filesystem::path& path) {

        try {
            std::ifstream file;
            return open_and_validate(path, file);
        } catch (const std::exception& e) {
            return std::unexpected(std::string("Read header failed: ") + e.what());
        }
    }

    CheckpointHeaderLoadResult load_checkpoint_header(
        std::istream& stream,
        const uint64_t file_size) {
        try {
            return read_and_validate(stream, file_size);
        } catch (const std::exception& e) {
            return std::unexpected(std::string("Read header failed: ") + e.what());
        }
    }

    std::expected<SplatData, std::string> load_checkpoint_splat_data(
        const std::filesystem::path& path,
        SplatTensorAllocator tensor_allocator) {

        try {
            std::ifstream file;
            auto header = open_and_validate(path, file);
            if (!header) {
                return std::unexpected(header.error());
            }

            if (auto skip_result = skip_strategy_name(file, *header); !skip_result)
                return std::unexpected(skip_result.error());

            SplatData splat;
            splat.deserialize(file, std::move(tensor_allocator));
            if (static_cast<uint64_t>(splat.size()) != header->num_gaussians)
                return std::unexpected("Invalid checkpoint: model count does not match header");
            if (splat.get_max_sh_degree() != header->sh_degree)
                return std::unexpected("Invalid checkpoint: model SH degree does not match header");

            LOG_DEBUG("SplatData loaded: {} Gaussians, iter {}", header->num_gaussians, header->iteration);
            return splat;

        } catch (const std::exception& e) {
            return std::unexpected(std::string("Load SplatData failed: ") + e.what());
        }
    }

    CheckpointSplatDataLoadResult load_checkpoint_splat_data(
        std::istream& stream,
        const uint64_t file_size,
        SplatTensorAllocator tensor_allocator) {
        try {
            auto header = read_and_validate(stream, file_size);
            if (!header) {
                return std::unexpected(header.error());
            }
            if (auto skip_result = skip_strategy_name(stream, *header);
                !skip_result) {
                return std::unexpected(skip_result.error());
            }

            SplatData splat;
            splat.deserialize(stream, std::move(tensor_allocator));
            if (static_cast<uint64_t>(splat.size()) != header->num_gaussians)
                return std::unexpected("Invalid checkpoint: model count does not match header");
            if (splat.get_max_sh_degree() != header->sh_degree)
                return std::unexpected("Invalid checkpoint: model SH degree does not match header");

            LOG_DEBUG("SplatData loaded from bounded CKPT: {} Gaussians, iter {}",
                      header->num_gaussians, header->iteration);
            return splat;
        } catch (const std::exception& e) {
            return std::unexpected(std::string("Load SplatData failed: ") + e.what());
        }
    }

    std::expected<param::TrainingParameters, std::string> load_checkpoint_params(
        const std::filesystem::path& path) {

        try {
            std::ifstream file;
            auto header = open_and_validate(path, file);
            if (!header) {
                return std::unexpected(header.error());
            }

            param::TrainingParameters params;
            if (header->params_json_size > 0) {
                file.seekg(static_cast<std::streamoff>(header->params_json_offset));
                std::string params_str(header->params_json_size, '\0');
                file.read(params_str.data(), static_cast<std::streamsize>(header->params_json_size));
                if (!file)
                    return std::unexpected("Invalid checkpoint: truncated parameter JSON");

                params = parse_checkpoint_params_json(params_str);
            }

            if (params.optimization.max_cap < 0)
                return std::unexpected("Invalid checkpoint parameters: max_cap must be nonnegative");
            if (static_cast<uint64_t>(params.optimization.max_cap) > MAX_CHECKPOINT_GAUSSIANS)
                return std::unexpected("Invalid checkpoint parameters: max_cap exceeds checkpoint limit");
            if (const auto validation_error = params.optimization.validate(); !validation_error.empty())
                return std::unexpected("Invalid checkpoint parameters: " + validation_error);
            if (const auto validation_error = params.dataset.validate(); !validation_error.empty())
                return std::unexpected("Invalid checkpoint dataset parameters: " + validation_error);
            if (!(params.freeze_lr_scale >= 0.0f && params.freeze_lr_scale <= 1.0f))
                return std::unexpected("Invalid checkpoint parameters: freeze_lr_scale must be within [0, 1]");
            LOG_DEBUG("Params loaded from checkpoint: {}", path_to_utf8(params.dataset.data_path));
            return params;

        } catch (const std::exception& e) {
            return std::unexpected(std::string("Load params failed: ") + e.what());
        }
    }

    CheckpointParametersLoadResult load_checkpoint_params(
        std::istream& stream,
        const uint64_t file_size) {
        try {
            auto header = read_and_validate(stream, file_size);
            if (!header) {
                return std::unexpected(header.error());
            }

            param::TrainingParameters params;
            if (header->params_json_size > 0) {
                stream.seekg(static_cast<std::streamoff>(header->params_json_offset));
                std::string params_str(header->params_json_size, '\0');
                stream.read(params_str.data(),
                            static_cast<std::streamsize>(header->params_json_size));
                if (!stream)
                    return std::unexpected("Invalid checkpoint: truncated parameter JSON");
                params = parse_checkpoint_params_json(params_str);
            }

            if (params.optimization.max_cap < 0)
                return std::unexpected("Invalid checkpoint parameters: max_cap must be nonnegative");
            if (static_cast<uint64_t>(params.optimization.max_cap) > MAX_CHECKPOINT_GAUSSIANS)
                return std::unexpected("Invalid checkpoint parameters: max_cap exceeds checkpoint limit");
            if (const auto validation_error = params.optimization.validate(); !validation_error.empty())
                return std::unexpected("Invalid checkpoint parameters: " + validation_error);
            if (const auto validation_error = params.dataset.validate(); !validation_error.empty())
                return std::unexpected("Invalid checkpoint dataset parameters: " + validation_error);
            if (!(params.freeze_lr_scale >= 0.0f && params.freeze_lr_scale <= 1.0f))
                return std::unexpected("Invalid checkpoint parameters: freeze_lr_scale must be within [0, 1]");
            return params;
        } catch (const std::exception& e) {
            return std::unexpected(std::string("Load params failed: ") + e.what());
        }
    }

    param::TrainingParameters parse_checkpoint_params_json(
        const std::string_view json_text,
        param::TrainingParameters base_params) {
        const auto params_json = nlohmann::json::parse(json_text);
        const auto validate_splat_composition = [](const param::TrainingParameters& params) {
            if (!params.add_splat_paths.empty() && !params.add_splat_freeze.empty() &&
                params.add_splat_paths.size() != params.add_splat_freeze.size()) {
                throw std::runtime_error(
                    "Invalid checkpoint parameters: add_splat_freeze count does not match add_splat_paths");
            }
        };
        if (!params_json.contains("optimization")) {
            base_params.optimization = param::OptimizationParameters::from_json(params_json);
            validate_splat_composition(base_params);
            return base_params;
        }

        base_params.optimization = param::OptimizationParameters::from_json(params_json["optimization"]);
        if (params_json.contains("dataset")) {
            base_params.dataset = param::DatasetConfig::from_json(params_json["dataset"]);
        }
        if (params_json.contains("init_path")) {
            base_params.init_path = params_json["init_path"].get<std::string>();
        }
        if (params_json.contains("server")) {
            base_params.server = param::ServerConfig::from_json(params_json["server"]);
        }
        if (params_json.contains("exclude_frozen_add_splats_from_export")) {
            base_params.exclude_frozen_add_splats_from_export =
                params_json["exclude_frozen_add_splats_from_export"].get<bool>();
        }
        if (params_json.contains("freeze_lr_scale")) {
            base_params.freeze_lr_scale = params_json["freeze_lr_scale"].get<float>();
        }
        if (params_json.contains("disabled_camera_uids")) {
            base_params.disabled_camera_uids = params_json["disabled_camera_uids"].get<std::vector<int>>();
        }

        const auto utf8_to_paths = [](const nlohmann::json& array) {
            std::vector<std::filesystem::path> paths;
            paths.reserve(array.size());
            for (const auto& entry : array) {
                paths.push_back(utf8_to_path(entry.get<std::string>()));
            }
            return paths;
        };
        if (params_json.contains("view_paths")) {
            base_params.view_paths = utf8_to_paths(params_json["view_paths"]);
        }
        if (params_json.contains("import_cameras_path")) {
            base_params.import_cameras_path =
                utf8_to_path(params_json["import_cameras_path"].get<std::string>());
        }
        if (params_json.contains("add_splat_paths")) {
            base_params.add_splat_paths = utf8_to_paths(params_json["add_splat_paths"]);
            base_params.add_splats_applied = true;
        }
        if (params_json.contains("add_splat_freeze")) {
            base_params.add_splat_freeze = params_json["add_splat_freeze"].get<std::vector<bool>>();
        }
        validate_splat_composition(base_params);
        return base_params;
    }

} // namespace lfs::core

### src/core/collision_volume.cpp
```
/* SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 LichtFeld Studio Authors
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later */
#include "core/collision_volume.hpp"
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <format>

namespace lfs::core {
    void CollisionSettings::validate() const {
        if (!std::isfinite(voxel_size) || voxel_size <= 0 || !std::isfinite(opacity) || opacity < 0 || opacity >= 1 ||
            !std::isfinite(max_gaussian_area) || max_gaussian_area < 0 || (!cleanup && max_gaussian_area > 0))
            throw collisionError("collision.settings_invalid",
                                 std::format("Invalid collision settings: voxel_size={} must be finite and positive, opacity={} must be finite in [0,1), max_gaussian_area={} must be finite and nonnegative and requires cleanup={} when positive",
                                             voxel_size, opacity, max_gaussian_area, cleanup),
                                 ErrorCode::InvalidArgument,
                                 std::format("{}; {}; {}; {}", voxel_size, opacity, max_gaussian_area, int(cleanup)));
    }
    bool CollisionVolume::occupied(glm::ivec3 p) const {
        if (glm::any(glm::lessThan(p, glm::ivec3(0))) || glm::any(glm::greaterThanEqual(p, dimensions)))
            return false;
        uint32_t value = words[0];
        for (int size = edge / 2; value > 1 && !(value & brick_tag); size /= 2)
            value = words[value - 2 + bool(p.x & size) + 2 * bool(p.y & size) + 4 * bool(p.z & size)];
        if (value <= 1)
            return value;
        const auto base = value & ~brick_tag;
        const auto mask = uint64_t(words[base]) | (uint64_t(words[base + 1]) << 32);
        return (mask >> ((p.x & 3) + 4 * (p.y & 3) + 16 * (p.z & 3))) & 1;
    }

    void CollisionVolume::validate() const {
        settings.validate();
        if (words.empty() || words.size() > max_words || edge < 4 || edge > (1 << 21) || (edge & (edge - 1)) ||
            glm::any(glm::lessThanEqual(dimensions, glm::ivec3(0))) || glm::any(glm::greaterThan(dimensions, glm::ivec3(edge))) ||
            !std::isfinite(origin.x) || !std::isfinite(origin.y) || !std::isfinite(origin.z))
            throw collisionError("collision.data_invalid", "Invalid collision volume bounds or storage", ErrorCode::InvalidArgument);
        std::vector<bool> seen(words.size());
        uint64_t count = 0;
        auto mark = [&](size_t i) {
            if (i >= words.size() || seen[i])
                throw collisionError("collision.data_invalid", "Invalid collision pointer or shared subtree", ErrorCode::InvalidArgument);
            seen[i] = true;
        };
        auto visit = [&](auto&& self, uint32_t i, glm::ivec3 lo, int size) -> void {
            mark(i);
            const auto v = words[i];
            if (v == 1) {
                const auto n = glm::max(glm::min(lo + size, dimensions) - lo, glm::ivec3(0));
                count += uint64_t(n.x) * n.y * n.z;
            } else if (v & brick_tag) {
                const auto base = v & ~brick_tag;
                if (size != 4 || base <= i)
                    throw collisionError("collision.data_invalid", "Invalid collision brick", ErrorCode::InvalidArgument);
                mark(base);
                mark(base + 1);
                const auto mask = uint64_t(words[base]) | (uint64_t(words[base + 1]) << 32);
                for (int b = 0; b < 64; ++b)
                    if (mask & (uint64_t(1) << b)) {
                        const auto p = lo + glm::ivec3(b & 3, (b >> 2) & 3, b >> 4);
                        if (glm::any(glm::greaterThanEqual(p, dimensions)))
                            throw collisionError("collision.data_invalid", "Collision brick contains occupied padding", ErrorCode::InvalidArgument);
                        ++count;
                    }
            } else if (v > 1) {
                if (size <= 4 || v - 2 <= i || uint64_t(v) + 6 > words.size())
                    throw collisionError("collision.data_invalid", "Invalid collision branch", ErrorCode::InvalidArgument);
                for (int c = 0; c < 8; ++c)
                    self(self, v - 2 + c, lo + glm::ivec3(c & 1, (c >> 1) & 1, c >> 2) * (size / 2), size / 2);
            }
        };
        visit(visit, 0, {}, edge);
        if (count != occupied_count || std::find(seen.begin(), seen.end(), false) != seen.end())
            throw collisionError("collision.data_invalid", "Collision occupancy count or topology is invalid", ErrorCode::InvalidArgument);
    }
    glm::mat4 collisionInverse(const glm::mat4& transform) {
        const double determinant = glm::determinant(glm::dmat3(transform));
        const auto inverse = glm::inverse(transform);
        if (!std::isfinite(determinant) || determinant == 0 || transform[0][3] != 0 ||
            transform[1][3] != 0 || transform[2][3] != 0 || transform[3][3] != 1)
            throw collisionError("collision.source_transform_invalid", "Collision transform must be invertible and affine", ErrorCode::InvalidArgument);
        for (int column = 0; column < 4; ++column)
            for (int row = 0; row < 4; ++row)
                if (!std::isfinite(transform[column][row]) || !std::isfinite(inverse[column][row]))
                    throw collisionError("collision.source_transform_invalid", "Collision transform or inverse is not finite", ErrorCode::InvalidArgument,
                                         std::format("[{}][{}]: {} / {}", column, row, transform[column][row], inverse[column][row]));
        return inverse;
    }
} // namespace lfs::core
```

/* SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 LichtFeld Studio Authors
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later */
#include "core/checked_arithmetic.hpp"
#include "core/collision.hpp"
#include "core/cuda/morton.cuh"
#include "core/logger.hpp"
#include "core/memory_pressure.hpp"
#include "core/splat_data.hpp"
#include "core/tensor/internal/cub_workspace.hpp"
#include "core/tensor/internal/cuda_stream_context.hpp"
#include "cuda/collision_voxelization_kernels.hpp"
#include <bit>
#include <climits>
#include <format>
#include <numbers>
#include <set>
namespace lfs::core::cuda {
    namespace {
        template <size_t N, class... Args>
        void launch(const char (&tag)[N], void (*kernel)(Args...), dim3 blocks, dim3 threads,
                    cudaStream_t stream, std::type_identity_t<Args>... args) {
            void* arguments[]{&args...};
            LFS_CUDA_CHECK(cudaLaunchKernel(kernel, blocks, threads, arguments, 0, stream));
            LFS_CUDA_LAUNCH_CHECK(stream, tag);
        }
        template <class T>
        struct Buffer {
            tensor_ops::ScopedDeviceBuffer storage;
            Buffer() = default;
            explicit Buffer(size_t n) { reserve(n); }
            T* data() const { return storage.template as<T>(); }
            size_t capacity() const { return storage.size() / sizeof(T); }
            void reserve(size_t n) {
                if (n > capacity())
                    storage = tensor_ops::ScopedDeviceBuffer(checked_product(n, sizeof(T), "Collision allocation"), getCurrentCUDAStream(), "collision");
            }
        };
    } // namespace
    size_t collisionOutputBytes(size_t count, size_t additional) {
        if (count > max_collision_records || additional > max_collision_records - count)
            throw collisionError("collision.output_limit",
                                 std::format("Collision output record limit exceeded: {} + {} records, limit {}. Choose a larger cell size or Automatic resolution; no output was coarsened or cropped", count, additional, max_collision_records),
                                 ErrorCode::ResourceExhausted, std::format("{} + {} > {}", count, additional, max_collision_records));
        return (count + additional) * sizeof(CollisionBrick);
    }
} // namespace lfs::core::cuda
namespace lfs::core {
    CollisionSource captureCollisionSource(const SplatData& data, const glm::mat4& transform, size_t begin, size_t count) {
        struct ReadFence {
            std::set<cudaStream_t> streams;
            cudaError_t finish() noexcept {
                auto first_error = cudaSuccess;
                for (const auto stream : streams) {
                    const auto status = cudaStreamSynchronize(stream);
                    if (first_error == cudaSuccess)
                        first_error = status;
                    ensure_cuda_success(status, "cudaStreamSynchronize(collision capture)",
                                        "Finishing source reads before releasing the caller's writer exclusion",
                                        LFS_SOURCE_SITE_CURRENT(), CudaFailureDisposition::LogOnly);
                }
                streams.clear();
                return first_error;
            }
            ~ReadFence() { (void)finish(); }
        } fence;
        for (const auto* tensor : {&data.means_raw(), &data.scaling_raw(), &data.rotation_raw(),
                                   &data.opacity_raw(), &data.deleted()})
            if (tensor->is_valid() && tensor->device() == Device::CUDA)
                fence.streams.insert(tensor->stream());
        if (!fence.streams.empty())
            fence.streams.insert(getCurrentCUDAStream());
        // Clones use the allocation/current stream; activations and deferred inputs
        // may use their home streams. Fence all of them, including partial LOD work.
        if (begin > data.size() || (count != SIZE_MAX && count > data.size() - begin))
            throw collisionError("collision.source_unavailable", "Collision source range is unavailable");
        count = std::min(count, data.size() - begin);
        const auto slice = [&](const Tensor& tensor) { return tensor.slice(0, begin, begin + count); };
        SplatData view;
        view.means_raw() = slice(data.means_raw());
        view.scaling_raw() = slice(data.scaling_raw());
        view.rotation_raw() = slice(data.rotation_raw());
        view.opacity_raw() = slice(data.opacity_raw());
        if (data.deleted().is_valid())
            view.deleted() = slice(data.deleted()).to(DataType::Bool);
        if (data.lod_tree && data.lod_tree->has_tree()) {
            if (data.size() != data.lod_tree->total_nodes())
                throw collisionError("collision.source_unavailable", "Collision requires resident original LOD leaves; load the complete model first");
            std::vector<bool> interior(count);
            for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i)
                interior[i] = data.lod_tree->child_count_at(begin + i) != 0;
            auto hidden = Tensor::from_vector(interior, {count}, view.means_raw().device());
            view.deleted() = view.deleted().is_valid() ? hidden.logical_or(view.deleted()) : hidden;
            if (data.lod_tree->lod_opacity_encoded)
                view.opacity_raw() = view.opacity_raw().logit();
        }
        CollisionSource source{view.means_raw().to(DataType::Float32), view.get_scaling().to(DataType::Float32),
                               view.get_rotation().to(DataType::Float32), view.get_opacity().to(DataType::Float32),
                               view.deleted(), transform};
        // Materialize lazy activations while the caller still excludes source writers.
        for (const auto* tensor : {&source.means, &source.scales, &source.rotations, &source.opacity, &source.deleted})
            if (tensor->is_valid())
                (void)tensor->data_ptr();
        LFS_ENSURE_CUDA_SUCCESS(fence.finish(), "Collision capture failed");
        return source;
    }
    CollisionVolume generateCollision(const CollisionSource& s, CollisionSettings settings, std::stop_token stop, ProgressCallback progress, std::function<void(float)> resolution, std::function<void(uint64_t)> mixed_blocks) {
        using namespace cuda;
        settings.validate();
        reportProgress(stop, progress, 0, collisionStage("gallery.transfer.phase.preparing", "Preparing collision geometry"));
        if (!s.means.is_valid() || s.means.ndim() != 2 || s.means.shape()[1] != 3)
            throw collisionError("collision.geometry_invalid", "Collision means must have shape [N,3]", ErrorCode::InvalidArgument);
        const auto total = s.means.shape()[0];
        if (!total || total > size_t(INT_MAX))
            throw collisionError("collision.geometry_invalid", "Collision source count exceeds the signed tensor index range or is empty", ErrorCode::InvalidArgument);
        const auto stream = getCurrentCUDAStream();
        if (!MemoryPressureCoordinator::instance().preflight({.operation = "Collision geometry",
                                                              .temporary_device_bytes = checked_product(total, 2 * sizeof(CollisionGaussianGpu) + 72, "Collision geometry")})
                 .ok)
            throw collisionError("collision.memory", "Insufficient GPU memory for collision geometry; free memory and retry", ErrorCode::ResourceExhausted);
        const auto blocks = [](size_t n) { return unsigned((n + 255) / 256); };
        Buffer<CollisionGaussianGpu> gs(total);
        auto metrics = Tensor::empty({total, 3}, Device::CUDA);
        auto bounds = Tensor::empty({6, total}, Device::CUDA);
        auto errors = Tensor::empty({1}, Device::CUDA, DataType::UInt32);
        LFS_CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemsetAsync(errors.ptr<uint32_t>(), 0, sizeof(uint32_t), stream));
        (void)collisionInverse(s.transform);
        {
            auto input = [&](const Tensor& tensor, size_t width, DataType type = DataType::Float32) {
                if (!tensor.is_valid() || tensor.numel() != total * width || tensor.dtype() != type)
                    throw collisionError("collision.geometry_invalid", "Invalid collision geometry tensor", ErrorCode::InvalidArgument);
                auto result = tensor.to(Device::CUDA, stream).contiguous();
                prepare_inputs_for_stream({&result}, stream);
                return result;
            };
            auto means = input(s.means, 3), scales = input(s.scales, 3);
            auto rotation = input(s.rotations, 4), opacity = input(s.opacity, 1);
            auto deleted = s.deleted.is_valid() ? input(s.deleted, 1, DataType::Bool) : Tensor{};
            launch("collision.prepare", prepare, blocks(total), 256, stream, means.ptr<float>(), scales.ptr<float>(), rotation.ptr<float>(), opacity.ptr<float>(), deleted.is_valid() ? deleted.ptr<bool>() : nullptr, total, s.transform, gs.data(), metrics.ptr<float>(), errors.ptr<uint32_t>());
        }
        if (errors.to(Device::CPU).ptr<uint32_t>()[0])
            throw collisionError("collision.geometry_nonfinite", "Non-finite Gaussian geometry: source or transformed positions, scales, rotations or opacity are not representable", ErrorCode::InvalidArgument);
        reportProgress(stop, progress, .04f, collisionStage("collision.cleanup", "Filtering collision sources"));
        std::array<float, 3> fences{INFINITY, INFINITY, INFINITY};
        float thin = -INFINITY;
        for (int a = 0; a < 3; ++a) {
            auto column = metrics.slice(1, a, a + 1).contiguous().reshape({int(total)});
            auto samples = column.masked_select(column.isfinite());
            if (!settings.cleanup || samples.numel() < size_t(a ? 128 : 16))
                continue;
            const auto sorted = samples.sort(0).first;
            const auto q1 = sorted.slice(0, samples.numel() / 4, samples.numel() / 4 + 1).item<float>();
            const auto q3 = sorted.slice(0, 3 * samples.numel() / 4, 3 * samples.numel() / 4 + 1).item<float>();
            fences[a] = q3 + std::max(3 * (q3 - q1), std::log(a ? 8.f : 64.f));
            if (a == 1)
                thin = q1 - std::log(4.f);
        }
        if (settings.max_gaussian_area)
            fences[0] = std::log(settings.max_gaussian_area / float(9 * std::numbers::pi));
        launch("collision.filter", filter, blocks(total), 256, stream, gs.data(), metrics.ptr<float>(), bounds.ptr<float>(), total, fences[0], fences[1], fences[2], thin);

        auto area = metrics.slice(1, 0, 1).contiguous().reshape({int(total)});
        auto retained = area.masked_select(area.isfinite());
        if (!retained.numel())
            throw collisionError("collision.cleanup_empty", "Source cleanup excluded all splats; disable cleanup or increase maximum area");
        if (retained.numel() * 10 < total)
            LOG_WARN("Collision source filtering retained {} of {} Gaussians; reduce filtering if coverage is incomplete", retained.numel(), total);
        if (settings.auto_resolution) {
            const auto sorted = retained.sort(0).first;
            const auto median = sorted.slice(0, retained.numel() / 2, retained.numel() / 2 + 1).item<float>();
            // Reserve fourfold surface-sample headroom; all terms scale with source geometry.
            settings.voxel_size = std::exp(median * .5f) * std::max(.1f, float(std::sqrt(retained.numel() * 4 * std::numbers::pi / 8'000'000)));
            settings.validate();
        }
        if (resolution)
            resolution(settings.voxel_size);
        auto bound = [&](bool high) {
            auto column = bounds.slice(0, high ? 3 : 0, high ? 6 : 3);
            auto reduced = (high ? column.max(1) : column.min(1)).to(Device::CPU).contiguous();
            return glm::vec3(reduced.ptr<float>()[0], reduced.ptr<float>()[1], reduced.ptr<float>()[2]);
        };
        auto low = bound(false), high = bound(true);
        {
            Buffer<uint64_t> key_in(total), key_out(total);
            Buffer<uint32_t> order_in(total), order_out(total);
            launch("collision.keys", keys, blocks(total), 256, stream, gs.data(), key_in.data(), order_in.data(), total, low,
                   {morton_multiplier(high.x - low.x), morton_multiplier(high.y - low.y), morton_multiplier(high.z - low.z)});

            sortCollisionSources(key_in.data(), key_out.data(), order_in.data(), order_out.data(), total, stream);
            Buffer<CollisionGaussianGpu> sorted(total);
            launch("collision.gather", gather, blocks(total), 256, stream, gs.data(), sorted.data(), order_out.data(), total);

            gs = std::move(sorted);
        }
        metrics = {};
        area = {};
        retained = {};
        const auto leaves = std::bit_ceil(uint32_t((total + 7) / 8));
        Buffer<CollisionBvhNode> bvh(2 * leaves - 1);
        auto build_bvh = [&] {
            launch("collision.leaf_bounds", leaf_bounds, blocks(leaves), 256, stream, gs.data(), bvh.data(), total, leaves, settings.voxel_size);

            for (auto first = leaves / 2; first; first /= 2) {
                launch("collision.parent_bounds", parent_bounds, blocks(first), 256, stream, bvh.data(), first);
            }
        };
        build_bvh();
        auto keep = Tensor::empty({total}, Device::CUDA, DataType::Bool);
        const auto cutoff = -std::log1p(-double(settings.opacity));
        launch("collision.eligible", eligible, blocks(total), 256, stream, gs.data(), bvh.data(), keep.ptr<bool>(), total, cutoff, settings.voxel_size);

        Grid grid{{0, 0, 0}, settings.voxel_size, {1, 1, 1}, cutoff};
        launch("collision.grid_indices", grid_indices, blocks(total), 256, stream, gs.data(), bounds.ptr<float>(), keep.ptr<bool>(), total, grid);

        low = bound(false);
        high = bound(true);
        if (!std::isfinite(low.x + low.y + low.z + high.x + high.y + high.z))
            throw collisionError("collision.empty", "No occupied support; lower opacity or check the source");
        CollisionVolume v{.settings = settings};
        v.origin = glm::floor((low - settings.voxel_size * .5f) / settings.voxel_size) * settings.voxel_size - 2 * settings.voxel_size;
        const auto dimensions = glm::ceil((glm::dvec3(high) + settings.voxel_size * .5 - glm::dvec3(v.origin)) / double(settings.voxel_size)) + 3.;
        if (glm::any(glm::lessThan(dimensions, glm::dvec3(1))) || glm::any(glm::greaterThan(dimensions, glm::dvec3(1 << 21))) || !std::isfinite(dimensions.x + dimensions.y + dimensions.z))
            throw collisionError("collision.output_limit", "Collision bounds exceed coordinate limits; increase cell size or remove remote outliers", ErrorCode::BoundsViolation, std::format("{} × {} × {}", dimensions.x, dimensions.y, dimensions.z));
        v.dimensions = glm::ivec3(dimensions);
        LOG_INFO("Collision grid {} x {} x {} at {} scene units; output limit {} sparse records", v.dimensions.x, v.dimensions.y, v.dimensions.z, settings.voxel_size, max_collision_records);
        v.edge = std::max(4u, std::bit_ceil(unsigned(std::max({v.dimensions.x, v.dimensions.y, v.dimensions.z}))));
        grid = {{v.origin.x, v.origin.y, v.origin.z}, settings.voxel_size, {v.dimensions.x, v.dimensions.y, v.dimensions.z}, cutoff};
        launch("collision.grid_indices", grid_indices, blocks(total), 256, stream, gs.data(), bounds.ptr<float>(), nullptr, total, grid);

        build_bvh();
        bounds = {};
        keep = {};
        errors = {};
        std::vector<Buffer<Region>> regions(std::countr_zero(unsigned(v.edge)) - 1);
        regions[0].reserve(1);
        LFS_CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemsetAsync(regions[0].data(), 0, sizeof(Region), stream));
        Buffer<uint32_t> count(2);
        Buffer<CollisionBrick> output;
        std::vector<Buffer<CollisionBrick>> chunks;
        size_t result_size = 0;
        uint64_t mixed_total = 0;
        auto preflight = [&](const char* phase, size_t additional, size_t records, size_t peak_bytes) {
            const auto memory = MemoryPressureCoordinator::instance().preflight({.operation = phase, .temporary_device_bytes = additional});
            if (!memory.ok)
                throw collisionError("collision.memory", std::format("{} needs {} additional bytes ({} available including reusable pools); {} records at cell size {}, output peak {} bytes. Free GPU memory or explicitly choose a larger cell size", phase, additional, memory.effective_free_bytes, records, settings.voxel_size, peak_bytes),
                                     ErrorCode::ResourceExhausted, std::format("{} B / {} B", additional, memory.effective_free_bytes));
        };
        auto append = [&](uint32_t n) {
            if (n > output.capacity())
                throw collisionError("selection.operation_failed_generic", "Collision dispatch exceeded its output buffer", ErrorCode::Internal);
            const auto bytes = collisionOutputBytes(result_size, n);
            if (!n)
                return;
            const auto chunk_bytes = size_t(n) * sizeof(CollisionBrick);
            preflight("Collision output growth", chunk_bytes, bytes / sizeof(CollisionBrick), bytes);
            try {
                chunks.emplace_back(n);
            } catch (const MemoryAllocationError& error) {
                throw collisionError("collision.memory", std::format("Collision output growth failed at {} records ({} bytes, limit {}): {}. Free GPU memory or choose a larger cell size", bytes / sizeof(CollisionBrick), bytes, max_collision_records, error.what()),
                                     ErrorCode::ResourceExhausted, std::format("{} B", bytes));
            }
            LFS_CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(chunks.back().data(), output.data(), size_t(n) * sizeof(CollisionBrick), cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, stream));
            result_size = bytes / sizeof(CollisionBrick);
        };
        const double volume = double(v.edge) * v.edge * v.edge;
        double completed = 0;
        auto visit = [&](auto&& self, int depth, int edge, uint32_t region_count) -> void {
            const bool split = edge > 4;
            for (uint32_t offset = 0; offset < region_count;) {
                reportProgress(stop, progress, .2f + .72f * float(std::clamp(completed / volume, 0., 1.)), collisionStage("new_project.create", "Voxelizing collision"));
                const auto batch = std::min(region_count - offset, split ? max_regions / 8 : 65536u);
                output.reserve(split ? size_t(batch) * 8 : batch);
                LFS_CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemsetAsync(count.data(), 0, 2 * sizeof(uint32_t), stream));
                if (split) {
                    regions[depth + 1].reserve(size_t(batch) * 8);
                    launch("collision.split_regions", split_regions, (uint64_t(batch) * 8 + 127) / 128, 128, stream, regions[depth].data(), offset, batch, edge, grid, gs.data(), bvh.data(), regions[depth + 1].data(), count.data(), output.data(), count.data() + 1);
                } else {
                    launch("collision.evaluate_bricks", evaluate_bricks, batch, 64, stream, regions[depth].data(), offset, grid, gs.data(), bvh.data(), output.data(), count.data());
                }
                std::array<uint32_t, 2> counts{};
                LFS_CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(counts.data(), count.data(), sizeof(counts), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream));
                LFS_CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));
                offset += batch;
                if (split) {
                    const double half = edge / 2;
                    completed += (uint64_t(batch) * 8 - counts[0]) * half * half * half;
                } else {
                    mixed_total += counts[1];
                    if (mixed_blocks)
                        mixed_blocks(mixed_total);
                    completed += batch * double(edge) * edge * edge;
                }
                append(counts[split ? 1 : 0]);
                if (split && counts[0])
                    self(self, depth + 1, edge / 2, counts[0]);
            }
        };
        visit(visit, 0, v.edge, 1);
        reportProgress(stop, progress, .93f, collisionStage("gallery.transfer.phase.processing", "Sorting collision records"));
        regions.clear();
        gs = {};
        bvh = {};
        output = {};
        Buffer<CollisionBrick> compact;
        LOG_INFO("Collision generated {} sparse records", result_size);
        const auto sort_bytes = queryCollisionSortWorkspaceBytes(result_size);
        const auto compact_bytes = collisionOutputBytes(result_size);
        const auto peak_bytes = saturating_add(compact_bytes, std::max(compact_bytes, sort_bytes));
        LOG_INFO("Collision compaction: {} records, {} bytes chunks + compact; sort peak {} bytes ({} workspace)", result_size, saturating_add(compact_bytes, compact_bytes), saturating_add(compact_bytes, sort_bytes), sort_bytes);
        preflight("Collision compaction", compact_bytes, result_size, peak_bytes);
        try {
            compact.reserve(result_size);
            size_t offset = 0;
            for (auto& chunk : chunks) {
                LFS_CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(compact.data() + offset, chunk.data(), chunk.capacity() * sizeof(CollisionBrick), cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, stream));
                offset += chunk.capacity();
                chunk = {};
            }
            // Complete copies and releases before accounting the next phase's pool capacity.
            LFS_CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));
            preflight("Collision sorting", sort_bytes, result_size, peak_bytes);
            if (result_size)
                sortCollisionBricks(compact.data(), result_size, stream);
        } catch (const MemoryAllocationError& error) {
            throw collisionError("collision.memory", std::format("Collision output allocation failed for {} records at cell size {} (compact {} bytes, sort workspace {} bytes). Free GPU memory or explicitly choose a larger cell size: {}", result_size, settings.voxel_size, compact_bytes, sort_bytes, error.what()),
                                 ErrorCode::ResourceExhausted, std::format("{} B + {} B", compact_bytes, sort_bytes));
        }
        std::vector<CollisionBrick> bricks(result_size);
        if (result_size)
            LFS_CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(bricks.data(), compact.data(), result_size * sizeof(CollisionBrick), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream));
        LFS_CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));
        compact = {};
        v.words.assign(1, 0);
        auto build = [&](auto&& self, uint32_t i, int size, size_t begin, size_t end) -> void {
            if (begin == end)
                return;
            reportProgress(stop, {}, 0, "");
            if (((bricks[begin].morton >> 57) && (4 << (bricks[begin].morton >> 57)) == uint64_t(size)) ||
                (size == 4 && bricks[begin].mask == ~uint64_t(0))) {
                v.words[i] = 1;
                v.occupied_count += uint64_t(size) * size * size;
            } else if (size == 4) {
                const auto mask = bricks[begin].mask;
                v.occupied_count += std::popcount(mask);
                if (v.words.size() > CollisionVolume::max_words - 2)
                    throw collisionError("collision.output_limit", "Collision brick pointer exceeds the packed address range", ErrorCode::ResourceExhausted);
                v.words[i] = CollisionVolume::brick_tag | uint32_t(v.words.size());
                v.words.insert(v.words.end(), {uint32_t(mask), uint32_t(mask >> 32)});
            } else {
                if (v.words.size() > CollisionVolume::max_words - 8)
                    throw collisionError("collision.output_limit", "Collision branch pointer exceeds the packed address range", ErrorCode::ResourceExhausted);
                const auto base = uint32_t(v.words.size());
                v.words.resize(base + 8);
                v.words[i] = base + 2;
                const int shift = 3 * (std::countr_zero(unsigned(size)) - 3);
                for (int c = 0; c < 8; ++c) {
                    const auto next = std::partition_point(bricks.begin() + begin, bricks.begin() + end,
                                                           [&](const auto& brick) { return ((brick.morton >> shift) & 7) == uint64_t(c); }) -
                                      bricks.begin();
                    self(self, base + c, size / 2, begin, next);
                    begin = next;
                }
                if (std::all_of(v.words.begin() + base, v.words.begin() + base + 8, [](auto n) { return n == 1; })) {
                    v.words[i] = 1;
                    v.words.resize(base);
                }
            }
        };
        reportProgress(stop, progress, .96f, collisionStage("gallery.transfer.phase.processing", "Assembling occupancy"));
        build(build, 0, v.edge, 0, bricks.size());
        if (!v.occupied_count)
            throw collisionError("collision.empty", "No occupied cells; lower opacity or check the source");
        v.validate();
        reportProgress(stop, progress, 1, collisionStage("status.ready", "Collision ready"));
        return v;
    }
} // namespace lfs::core
