/* SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 LichtFeld Studio Authors
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later */
#include "core/collision.hpp"
#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cmath>

namespace lfs::core {
    namespace {
        bool finite(glm::vec3 p) {
            return std::isfinite(p.x) && std::isfinite(p.y) && std::isfinite(p.z);
        }
        bool segmentBox(glm::vec3 a, glm::vec3 b, glm::vec3 lo, glm::vec3 hi, float radius) {
            const auto delta = b - a;
            const auto separation = glm::max(glm::max(lo - glm::max(a, b), glm::min(a, b) - hi), glm::vec3(0));
            if (glm::dot(separation, separation) >= radius * radius)
                return false;
            std::array<float, 8> times{0, 1};
            int count = 2;
            for (int axis = 0; axis < 3; ++axis)
                if (std::abs(delta[axis]) > 1e-12f)
                    for (const float plane : {lo[axis], hi[axis]}) {
                        const float t = (plane - a[axis]) / delta[axis];
                        if (t > 0 && t < 1)
                            times[count++] = t;
                    }
            std::sort(times.begin(), times.begin() + count);
            // Squared segment/box distance is quadratic between box-plane crossings.
            for (int i = 1; i < count; ++i) {
                const float left = times[i - 1], right = times[i], mid = (left + right) * .5f;
                const auto point = a + delta * mid;
                const auto bound = glm::clamp(point, lo, hi);
                const auto slope = delta * glm::vec3(glm::notEqual(point, bound));
                const float numerator = glm::dot(slope, a - bound), denominator = glm::dot(slope, slope);
                const float t = denominator > 0 ? glm::clamp(-numerator / denominator, left, right) : mid;
                const auto p = a + delta * t;
                const auto distance = p - glm::clamp(p, lo, hi);
                if (glm::dot(distance, distance) < radius * radius)
                    return true;
            }
            return false;
        }
        template <typename Hit, typename Contact>
        bool scanSweep(float length, float extent, float spacing, const Hit& hit, const Contact& contact) {
            const double required = std::ceil(double(length) / spacing);
            if (required > 4096)
                throw collisionError("collision.walk_budget", "Walk movement exceeds the sweep budget", ErrorCode::ResourceExhausted);
            const int count = std::max(1, static_cast<int>(required));
            float clear = 0;
            for (int i = 1; i <= count; ++i) {
                float boundary = extent * i / count;
                if (hit(boundary)) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < 16; ++j) {
                        const float mid = (clear + boundary) * .5f;
                        if (hit(mid))
                            boundary = mid;
                        else
                            clear = mid;
                    }
                    if (contact(boundary))
                        return true;
                } else
                    clear = boundary;
            }
            return false;
        }
        struct Sweep {
            glm::vec3 position;
            bool hit = false;
        };
        template <typename Hit>
        Sweep sweep(glm::vec3 start, glm::vec3 delta, float spacing, const Hit& hit) {
            const float length = glm::length(delta);
            if (length == 0)
                return {start};
            Sweep result{start};
            const auto probe = [&](float t) {
                const auto point = start + delta * t;
                if (hit(point))
                    return true;
                result.position = point;
                return false;
            };
            result.hit = scanSweep(length, 1, spacing, probe, [](float) { return true; });
            return result;
        }
    } // namespace
    void WalkSettings::validate() const {
        for (float value : {height, radius, speed})
            if (!std::isfinite(value) || value <= 0)
                throw collisionError("preferences.viewport_defaults_invalid", "Walk dimensions and speed must be finite and positive", ErrorCode::InvalidArgument);
        if (!std::isfinite(step) || step < 0 || step > height || height < 2 * radius)
            throw collisionError("preferences.viewport_defaults_invalid", "Invalid Walk capsule or step height", ErrorCode::InvalidArgument);
    }

    bool collisionCapsuleIntersects(const CollisionVolume& volume, const glm::mat4& transform,
                                    glm::vec3 feet, glm::vec3 up, float height, float radius) {
        if (!finite(feet) || !finite(up) || !std::isfinite(height) || !std::isfinite(radius) ||
            radius <= 0 || height < 2 * radius || glm::length(up) < 1e-6f)
            throw collisionError("preferences.viewport_defaults_invalid", "Invalid collision capsule", ErrorCode::InvalidArgument);
        const auto inverse = collisionInverse(transform);
        up = glm::normalize(up);
        const auto linear = glm::mat3(inverse);
        const auto transposed = glm::transpose(linear);
        float norm1 = 0, norm_inf = 0, max_scale = 0;
        bool orthogonal = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
            max_scale = std::max(max_scale, glm::length(linear[i]));
            for (int j = 0; j < 3; ++j)
                if (i != j && std::abs(glm::dot(linear[i], linear[j])) > 1e-5f * glm::length(linear[i]) * glm::length(linear[j]))
                    orthogonal = false;
            norm1 = std::max(norm1, glm::dot(glm::abs(linear[i]), glm::vec3(1)));
            norm_inf = std::max(norm_inf, glm::dot(glm::abs(transposed[i]), glm::vec3(1)));
        }
        // Exact for rigid/uniform transforms; conservative for nonuniform scale/shear.
        const float world_radius = radius;
        radius *= orthogonal ? max_scale : std::sqrt(norm1 * norm_inf);
        const auto a = glm::vec3(inverse * glm::vec4(feet + up * world_radius, 1));
        const auto b = glm::vec3(inverse * glm::vec4(feet + up * (height - world_radius), 1));
        const auto overlaps = [&](glm::ivec3 lo, glm::ivec3 hi) {
            return segmentBox(a, b, volume.origin + glm::vec3(lo) * volume.settings.voxel_size,
                              volume.origin + glm::vec3(hi) * volume.settings.voxel_size, radius);
        };
        size_t visited = 0;
        auto visit = [&](auto&& self, uint32_t index, glm::ivec3 lo, int edge) -> bool {
            const auto value = volume.words[index];
            if (!value || glm::any(glm::greaterThanEqual(lo, volume.dimensions)))
                return false;
            if (++visited > 2'000'000)
                throw collisionError("collision.walk_budget", "Walk query exceeds the tree budget", ErrorCode::ResourceExhausted);
            if (!overlaps(lo, glm::min(lo + edge, volume.dimensions)))
                return false;
            if (value == 1)
                return true;
            if (value & CollisionVolume::brick_tag) {
                for (int bit = 0; bit < 64; ++bit) {
                    if (!(volume.words[(value & ~CollisionVolume::brick_tag) + bit / 32] & (1u << (bit % 32))))
                        continue;
                    const auto p = lo + glm::ivec3(bit % 4, (bit / 4) % 4, bit / 16);
                    if (glm::all(glm::lessThan(p, volume.dimensions)) && overlaps(p, p + 1))
                        return true;
                }
                return false;
            }
            for (int child = 0; child < 8; ++child)
                if (self(self, value - 2 + child, lo + glm::ivec3(child & 1, (child >> 1) & 1, child >> 2) * (edge / 2), edge / 2))
                    return true;
            return false;
        };
        return visit(visit, 0, glm::ivec3(0), volume.edge);
    }

    void settleWalk(WalkState& state, const WalkSettings& settings, glm::vec3 up, const CapsuleQuery& blocked) {
        settings.validate();
        if (!finite(state.eye) || !finite(up) || glm::length(up) < 1e-6f)
            throw collisionError("preferences.viewport_defaults_invalid", "Invalid Walk spawn", ErrorCode::InvalidArgument);
        up = glm::normalize(up);
        const auto feet = state.eye - up * settings.height;
        auto hit = [&](glm::vec3 p) { return blocked(p, up, settings.height, settings.radius); };
        if (hit(feet))
            throw collisionError("collision.walk_blocked", "Walk capsule does not fit at the camera");
        const auto support = sweep(feet, -up * (2 * settings.height), settings.radius / 3, hit);
        if (!support.hit)
            throw collisionError("collision.walk_no_support", "No Walk support below the camera");
        state.feet = support.position;
        state.eye = state.feet + up * settings.height;
        state.presentation = state.eye;
        state.grounded = true;
    }

    void advanceWalk(WalkState& state, const WalkSettings& settings, glm::vec3 up, glm::vec3 velocity,
                     float dt, const CapsuleQuery& blocked) {
        settings.validate();
        if (!finite(up) || !finite(velocity) || !finite(state.eye) || !finite(state.presentation) || !finite(state.feet) || !state.grounded ||
            !std::isfinite(dt) || dt < 0 || glm::length(up) < 1e-6f)
            throw collisionError("preferences.viewport_defaults_invalid", "Invalid Walk input", ErrorCode::InvalidArgument);
        up = glm::normalize(up);
        dt = std::min(dt, .1f);
        velocity -= up * glm::dot(velocity, up);
        auto feet = state.feet;
        const float spacing = settings.radius / 3;
        auto hit = [&](glm::vec3 p) { return blocked(p, up, settings.height, settings.radius); };
        if (hit(feet))
            throw collisionError("collision.walk_blocked", "Walk capsule overlaps collision geometry at its current position");
        const auto displacement = velocity * dt;
        const auto travel = sweep(feet, displacement, spacing, hit);
        const auto foot_clear = [&](float lift) {
            return !blocked(feet + displacement + up * lift, up, 2 * settings.radius, settings.radius);
        };
        const auto try_step = [&](float high) {
            const auto lift = sweep(feet, up * high, spacing, hit);
            const auto across = sweep(lift.position, displacement, spacing, hit);
            const auto down = sweep(across.position, -up * (high + settings.radius * .001f), spacing, hit);
            if (lift.hit || across.hit || !down.hit)
                return false;
            feet = down.position;
            return true;
        };
        const bool stepped = travel.hit && settings.step > 0 &&
                             scanSweep(settings.step, settings.step, spacing, foot_clear, try_step);
        if (!stepped) {
            feet = travel.position;
            if (travel.hit)
                for (int axis = 0; axis < 3; ++axis) {
                    glm::vec3 delta(0);
                    delta[axis] = (displacement - (travel.position - state.feet))[axis];
                    delta -= up * glm::dot(delta, up);
                    feet = sweep(feet, delta, spacing, hit).position;
                }
        }
        const auto support_delta = -up * std::max(settings.step, settings.radius * .001f);
        const auto down = sweep(feet, support_delta, spacing, hit);
        if (!down.hit) {
            // Refuse an unsupported move while retaining Walk and its last safe body.
            // Actual removal of the supporting geometry remains an explicit failure.
            if (!sweep(state.feet, support_delta, spacing, hit).hit)
                throw collisionError("collision.walk_no_support", "Walk support is no longer present");
            return;
        }
        state.feet = down.position;
        state.eye = state.feet + up * settings.height;
        const float offset = glm::clamp(glm::dot(state.presentation - state.eye, up) * std::exp(-20 * dt),
                                        -settings.step, settings.step);
        auto head_hit = [&](glm::vec3 eye) { return blocked(eye - up * (2 * settings.radius), up, 2 * settings.radius, settings.radius); };
        state.presentation = sweep(state.eye, up * offset, spacing, head_hit).position;
    }
} // namespace lfs::core
```

namespace lfs::core {

#ifndef LFS_UNICODE_TEST_STANDALONE
    namespace {
        constexpr int kMaxGpuPreShutdownHooks = 32;
        std::array<GpuPreShutdownHook, kMaxGpuPreShutdownHooks> g_gpu_pre_shutdown_hooks{};
        std::atomic<int> g_gpu_pre_shutdown_hook_count{0};
        std::atomic<bool> g_gpu_pre_shutdown_hooks_ran{false};
        std::atomic<bool> g_gpu_process_teardown_started{false};
        std::atomic<bool> g_gpu_pre_shutdown_overflow_logged{false};

        void run_gpu_pre_shutdown_hooks_once() noexcept {
            bool expected = false;
            if (!g_gpu_pre_shutdown_hooks_ran.compare_exchange_strong(
                    expected, true, std::memory_order_acq_rel)) {
                return;
            }
            const int n = g_gpu_pre_shutdown_hook_count.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
            for (int i = 0; i < n && i < kMaxGpuPreShutdownHooks; ++i) {
                if (GpuPreShutdownHook hook = g_gpu_pre_shutdown_hooks[static_cast<size_t>(i)]) {
                    try {
                        hook();
                    } catch (...) {
                        // LFS-CENSUS-OK(empty-catch): hooks must not escape;
                        // continue remaining holders so pool shutdown still runs.
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    } // namespace

    void register_gpu_pre_shutdown_hook(const GpuPreShutdownHook hook) noexcept {
        if (!hook) {
            return;
        }
        const int index = g_gpu_pre_shutdown_hook_count.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
        if (index < 0 || index >= kMaxGpuPreShutdownHooks) {
            if (!g_gpu_pre_shutdown_overflow_logged.exchange(true, std::memory_order_relaxed)) {
                try {
                    LOG_ERROR("register_gpu_pre_shutdown_hook: capacity {} exceeded; "
                              "hook dropped during static/TLS release",
                              kMaxGpuPreShutdownHooks);
                } catch (...) {
                }
            }
            return;
        }
        g_gpu_pre_shutdown_hooks[static_cast<size_t>(index)] = hook;
    }

    bool gpu_process_teardown_started() noexcept {
        return g_gpu_process_teardown_started.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    }
#endif

    void flush_diagnostics_noexcept() noexcept {
        try {
            Logger::get().flush();
        } catch (...) {
        }
    }

#ifndef LFS_UNICODE_TEST_STANDALONE
    void teardown_gpu_before_exit() noexcept {
        try {
            // release every registered long-lived CUDA holder
            // (TLS FastGS sort workspaces, rasterizer image caches, PPISP shared
            // statics, mirror mult cache, nan-check scratch,) while the pool
            // and CUDA context are still usable. After this returns, static/TLS
            // dtors must find empty holders; otherwise they free after the
            // Meyers-singleton pool is destroyed causes SIGSEGV (exit 139).
            run_gpu_pre_shutdown_hooks_once();
            g_gpu_process_teardown_started.store(true, std::memory_order_release);

            // Drain dedicated DeviceFaultRecord slots (cudaMalloc-owned, never
            // pool memory) before the tensor memory
            // pool shuts down. device_fault_registry_teardown is no-throw and
            // idempotent (LFS_CUDA_LOG_TEARDOWN on every free).
            device_fault_registry_teardown();
            GlobalArenaManager::instance().shutdown();
            Tensor::shutdown_memory_pool();
            PinnedMemoryAllocator::instance().shutdown();
        } catch (...) {
            // LFS-CENSUS-OK(empty-catch): subsystem teardown reports CUDA
            // failures internally; none may escape this sanctioned pre-exit step.
        }
    }
#endif

    [[noreturn]] void flush_and_exit(const int code) noexcept {
        flush_diagnostics_noexcept();
        std::_Exit(code);
    }

    namespace {

        constexpr int EXCEPTION_FIREWALL_EXIT_CODE = 70; // EX_SOFTWARE

        std::filesystem::path g_crash_log_path;
        std::once_flag g_install_once;
        std::mutex g_crash_log_mutex;

#ifdef _WIN32
        std::filesystem::path g_crash_log_native_path;

        HANDLE open_crash_log() noexcept {
            if (g_crash_log_path.empty())
                return INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE;
            return CreateFileW(g_crash_log_native_path.c_str(), FILE_APPEND_DATA, FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE,
                               nullptr, OPEN_ALWAYS, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, nullptr);
        }

        LONG WINAPI unhandled_exception_filter(EXCEPTION_POINTERS* exception) {
            const HANDLE crash_log = open_crash_log();
            if (crash_log != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) {
                std::array<char, 256> header{};
                const DWORD code = exception && exception->ExceptionRecord
                                       ? exception->ExceptionRecord->ExceptionCode
                                       : 0;
                const int length = std::snprintf(
                    header.data(), header.size(),
                    "LichtFeld Studio unhandled exception 0x%08lx\r\n", code);
                DWORD written = 0;
                if (length > 0) {
                    WriteFile(crash_log, header.data(), static_cast<DWORD>(length), &written, nullptr);
                }

                std::array<void*, 64> frames{};
                const USHORT count = CaptureStackBackTrace(
                    0, static_cast<DWORD>(frames.size()), frames.data(), nullptr);
                for (USHORT i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
                    const int frame_length = std::snprintf(
                        header.data(), header.size(), "  #%u %p\r\n", i, frames[i]);
                    if (frame_length > 0) {
                        WriteFile(crash_log, header.data(),
                                  static_cast<DWORD>(frame_length), &written, nullptr);
                    }
                }
                FlushFileBuffers(crash_log);
                CloseHandle(crash_log);
            }
            return EXCEPTION_CONTINUE_SEARCH;
        }
#else
        int open_crash_log() noexcept {
            if (g_crash_log_path.empty())
                return -1;
            return ::open(g_crash_log_path.c_str(), O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_APPEND | O_CLOEXEC, 0600);
        }

        void write_signal_text(const int fd, const char* text, const size_t length) noexcept {
            if (fd < 0) {
                return;
            }
            size_t offset = 0;
            while (offset < length) {
                const ssize_t written = ::write(fd, text + offset, length - offset);
                if (written <= 0) {
                    return;
                }
                offset += static_cast<size_t>(written);
            }
        }

        void fatal_signal_handler(const int signal_number) noexcept {
            static constexpr char SIGSEGV_HEADER[] =
                "LichtFeld Studio fatal signal SIGSEGV; backtrace follows\n";
            static constexpr char SIGABRT_HEADER[] =
                "LichtFeld Studio fatal signal SIGABRT; backtrace follows\n";
            static constexpr char SIGFPE_HEADER[] =
                "LichtFeld Studio fatal signal SIGFPE; backtrace follows\n";
            static constexpr char SIGBUS_HEADER[] =
                "LichtFeld Studio fatal signal SIGBUS; backtrace follows\n";
            static constexpr char UNKNOWN_HEADER[] =
                "LichtFeld Studio fatal signal; backtrace follows\n";

            const int fd = open_crash_log();
            switch (signal_number) {
            case SIGSEGV:
                write_signal_text(fd, SIGSEGV_HEADER, sizeof(SIGSEGV_HEADER) - 1);
                break;
            case SIGABRT:
                write_signal_text(fd, SIGABRT_HEADER, sizeof(SIGABRT_HEADER) - 1);
                break;
            case SIGFPE:
                write_signal_text(fd, SIGFPE_HEADER, sizeof(SIGFPE_HEADER) - 1);
                break;
            case SIGBUS:
                write_signal_text(fd, SIGBUS_HEADER, sizeof(SIGBUS_HEADER) - 1);
                break;
            default:
                write_signal_text(fd, UNKNOWN_HEADER, sizeof(UNKNOWN_HEADER) - 1);
                break;
            }

            // glibc may
            // lazily load unwind support on its first backtrace(), so installation prewarms it.
            std::array<void*, 128> frames{};
            const int count = ::backtrace(frames.data(), static_cast<int>(frames.size()));
            if (fd >= 0 && count > 0) {
                ::backtrace_symbols_fd(frames.data(), count, fd);
                if (fd >= 0)
                    ::close(fd);
            }

            struct sigaction action {};
            action.sa_handler = SIG_DFL;
            sigemptyset(&action.sa_mask);
            action.sa_flags = 0;
            ::sigaction(signal_number, &action, nullptr);

            // A signal is blocked while its handler runs. Unblock it before
            // re-sending so the restored default disposition (and core-dump
            // policy) actually takes effect instead of being bypassed by the
            // fallback _exit below.
            sigset_t unblock_set;
            sigemptyset(&unblock_set);
            sigaddset(&unblock_set, signal_number);
            ::sigprocmask(SIG_UNBLOCK, &unblock_set, nullptr);
            ::kill(::getpid(), signal_number);
            _exit(128 + signal_number);
        }
#endif

        // Shared by the terminate handler and the dispatch firewall: describes
        // whatever exception is active in the calling catch block and emits it
        // through the standard failure-report path. Best effort: swallows its
        // own failures so callers can rely on it never throwing.
        void report_current_exception(const std::string_view family,
                                      const std::string_view contract,
                                      const FailureReportSeverity severity) noexcept {
            std::string exception_type = "<no active exception>";
            std::string what;
            if (const std::exception_ptr exception = std::current_exception()) {
                try {
                    std::rethrow_exception(exception);
                } catch (const std::exception& error) {
                    exception_type = typeid(error).name();
                    what = error.what();
                } catch (...) {
                    exception_type = "<non-std exception>";
                }
            }

            try {
                const auto location = LFS_SOURCE_SITE_CURRENT();
                const std::string message = std::format(
                    "active_exception_type={}, what={}", exception_type,
                    what.empty() ? "<unavailable>" : what);
                emit_failure_report(
                    FailureReport{
                        .family = family,
                        .contract = contract,
                        .expression = "uncaught exception",
                        .message = message,
                        .location = location,
                        .stacktrace_skip_frames = 3,
                    },
                    severity);
            } catch (...) {
            }
        }

        [[noreturn]] void terminate_handler() noexcept {
            report_current_exception("process termination", "std::terminate", FailureReportSeverity::Critical);
            flush_diagnostics_noexcept();
            std::abort();
        }

        [[nodiscard]] bool crash_handlers_disabled() noexcept {
            return environment::flag("LFS_NO_CRASH_HANDLER");
        }

    } // namespace

    void write_crash_diagnostic(const std::string_view text) noexcept {
        try {
            const std::lock_guard lock(g_crash_log_mutex);
#ifdef _WIN32
            const HANDLE crash_log = open_crash_log();
            if (crash_log == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE)
                return;
            size_t offset = 0;
            while (offset < text.size()) {
                const DWORD chunk = static_cast<DWORD>(std::min<size_t>(text.size() - offset, MAXDWORD));
                DWORD written = 0;
                if (!WriteFile(crash_log, text.data() + offset, chunk, &written, nullptr) || written == 0) {
                    CloseHandle(crash_log);
                    return;
                }
                offset += written;
            }
            DWORD written = 0;
            WriteFile(crash_log, "\n", 1, &written, nullptr);
            FlushFileBuffers(crash_log);
            CloseHandle(crash_log);
#else
            const int fd = open_crash_log();
            write_signal_text(fd, text.data(), text.size());
            write_signal_text(fd, "\n", 1);
            if (fd >= 0) {
                (void)::fsync(fd);
                ::close(fd);
            }
#endif
        } catch (...) {
            // LFS-CENSUS-OK(empty-catch): A diagnostic sink failure must not recurse
            // into failure reporting or replace the original failure.
        }
    }

    void install_crash_handlers() {
        std::call_once(g_install_once, [] {
            if (crash_handlers_disabled()) {
                std::fprintf(stderr, "Crash handlers disabled by LFS_NO_CRASH_HANDLER=1\n");
                return;
            }

            const auto paths = UserPaths::resolve();
            if (paths) {
                std::error_code error;
                lfs::core::native_fs::create_directories(paths->logDir(), error);
                if (!error) {
                    const auto date = std::chrono::floor<std::chrono::seconds>(std::chrono::system_clock::now());
#ifdef _WIN32
                    const auto pid = GetCurrentProcessId();
#else
                    const auto pid = ::getpid();
#endif
                    g_crash_log_path = paths->logDir() /
                                       std::format("lichtfeld-studio-crash-{:%Y-%m-%d-%H%M%S}-{}.log", date, pid);
#ifdef _WIN32
                    g_crash_log_native_path = lfs::core::native_fs::native_path(g_crash_log_path);
#endif
                } else {
                    std::fprintf(stderr, "Could not create crash log directory: %s\n", error.message().c_str());
                }
            } else {
                std::fprintf(stderr, "Could not resolve LichtFeld home for crash logs\n");
            }
#ifdef _WIN32
            SetUnhandledExceptionFilter(unhandled_exception_filter);
#else
            std::array<void*, 1> warmup{};
            (void)::backtrace(warmup.data(), static_cast<int>(warmup.size()));

            struct sigaction action {};
            action.sa_handler = fatal_signal_handler;
            sigemptyset(&action.sa_mask);
            action.sa_flags = SA_RESETHAND;
            for (const int signal_number : {SIGSEGV, SIGABRT, SIGFPE, SIGBUS}) {
                ::sigaction(signal_number, &action, nullptr);
            }
#endif

            std::set_terminate(terminate_handler);
            const std::string path = path_to_utf8(g_crash_log_path);
            std::fprintf(stderr, "Crash diagnostics: %s\n", path.c_str());
        });
    }

    int run_with_exception_firewall(const std::function<int()>& fn) noexcept {
        try {
            return fn();
        } catch (...) {
            report_current_exception("process dispatch", "exception firewall", FailureReportSeverity::Error);
            flush_diagnostics_noexcept();
            return EXCEPTION_FIREWALL_EXIT_CODE;
        }
    }

} // namespace lfs::core

/* SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 LichtFeld Studio Authors
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later */

#include "core/crop_polygon.hpp"

namespace lfs::core::crop_polygon {

    namespace {
        [[nodiscard]] bool isFinite(const glm::vec3& v) {
            return std::isfinite(v.x) && std::isfinite(v.y) && std::isfinite(v.z);
        }
    } // namespace

    std::optional<Plane> makePlane(const glm::vec3& camera_forward, const glm::vec3& point) {
        const float length = glm::length(camera_forward);
        if (!isFinite(camera_forward) || !isFinite(point) || !(length > 1e-8f))
            return std::nullopt;
        return Plane{.point = point, .normal = camera_forward / length};
    }

    bool pivotIsInFront(const glm::vec3& camera_position, const glm::vec3& camera_forward,
                        const glm::vec3& pivot) {
        const float length = glm::length(camera_forward);
        if (!isFinite(camera_position) || !isFinite(camera_forward) || !isFinite(pivot) || !(length > 1e-8f))
            return false;
        return glm::dot(pivot - camera_position, camera_forward / length) > kMinHalfDepth;
    }

    std::optional<Plane> makeDrawingPlane(const glm::vec3& camera_position, const glm::vec3& camera_forward,
                                          const glm::vec3& pivot,
                                          const std::optional<glm::vec3>& first_click_point) {
        if (pivotIsInFront(camera_position, camera_forward, pivot))
            return makePlane(camera_forward, pivot);
        return first_click_point ? makePlane(camera_forward, *first_click_point) : std::nullopt;
    }

    std::optional<Ray> rayThroughPoints(const glm::vec3& near_point, const glm::vec3& far_point) {
        const glm::vec3 direction = far_point - near_point;
        const float length = glm::length(direction);
        if (!isFinite(near_point) || !isFinite(far_point) || !std::isfinite(length) || !(length > 1e-12f))
            return std::nullopt;
        return Ray{.origin = near_point, .direction = direction / length};
    }

    std::optional<glm::vec3> intersect(const Ray& ray, const Plane& plane) {
        const float denominator = glm::dot(ray.direction, plane.normal);
        if (!std::isfinite(denominator) || std::abs(denominator) < 1e-6f)
            return std::nullopt;
        const float t = glm::dot(plane.point - ray.origin, plane.normal) / denominator;
        if (!std::isfinite(t) || t < 0.0f)
            return std::nullopt;
        const glm::vec3 hit = ray.origin + ray.direction * t;
        return isFinite(hit) ? std::optional<glm::vec3>(hit) : std::nullopt;
    }

    std::optional<Frame> buildFrame(const std::span<const glm::vec3> world_points,
                                    const Plane& plane,
                                    const glm::vec3& camera_right) {
        const float normal_length = glm::length(plane.normal);
        if (world_points.size() < kMinVertices || world_points.size() > kMaxVertices ||
            !isFinite(plane.point) || !isFinite(plane.normal) || !(normal_length > 1e-8f))
            return std::nullopt;

        const glm::vec3 z = plane.normal / normal_length;
        glm::vec3 x = camera_right - glm::dot(camera_right, z) * z;
        if (!isFinite(x) || !(glm::length(x) > 1e-6f))
            return std::nullopt;
        x = glm::normalize(x);
        // x right, y = z cross x points down the image: the dataset camera's right-handed axes.
        const glm::vec3 y = glm::cross(z, x);

        std::vector<glm::vec2> in_plane;
        in_plane.reserve(world_points.size());
        glm::vec2 lo(std::numeric_limits<float>::max());
        glm::vec2 hi(std::numeric_limits<float>::lowest());
        for (const glm::vec3& point : world_points) {
            const glm::vec3 offset = point - plane.point;
            const glm::vec2 uv(glm::dot(offset, x), glm::dot(offset, y));
            lo = glm::min(lo, uv);
            hi = glm::max(hi, uv);
            in_plane.push_back(uv);
        }
        const glm::vec2 centre = (lo + hi) * 0.5f;
        for (glm::vec2& uv : in_plane)
            uv -= centre;
        if (!isValidOutline(in_plane))
            return std::nullopt;

        const glm::vec3 origin = plane.point + x * centre.x + y * centre.y;
        const glm::vec2 half_extents = (hi - lo) * 0.5f;
        const float half_depth = std::max(std::max(half_extents.x, half_extents.y), kMinHalfDepth);
        if (!std::isfinite(half_depth) || !isFinite(origin))
            return std::nullopt;

        return Frame{
            .world_from_local = glm::mat4(glm::vec4(x, 0.0f), glm::vec4(y, 0.0f), glm::vec4(z, 0.0f),
                                          glm::vec4(origin, 1.0f)),
            .vertices = std::move(in_plane),
            .half_depth = half_depth,
        };
    }

} // namespace lfs::core::crop_polygon
```

/* SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 LichtFeld Studio Authors

#include "core/cuda_error.hpp"

#include "core/device_fault.hpp"
